source.text: הַדָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־הָיָ֤ה אֶֽל־יִרְמְיָ֨הוּ֙ מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה אַחַ֣ר׀שַׁלַּ֣ח אֹת֗וֹ נְבוּזַרְאֲדָ֛ן רַב־טַבָּחִ֖ים מִן־הָֽרָמָ֑ה בְּקַחְתּ֣וֹ אֹת֗וֹ וְהֽוּא־אָס֤וּר בָּֽאזִקִּים֙ בְּת֨וֹךְ כָּל־גָּל֤וּת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ וִֽיהוּדָ֔ה הַמֻּגְלִ֖ים בָּבֶֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: The word that came to Jeremiah from with Yahweh after released him Nebuzaradan [the] chief of [the] guard from Ramah, when he took him, and he [was] bound in chains in [the] midst of all [the] exiles of Jerusalem and Judah who [were] being exiled to Babylon.

en.L: The word that came to Jeremiah from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, after Nebuzaradan the chief of the guard had released him from Ramah, when he took him, and he [was] bound in chains among all the exiles of Jerusalem and Judah who were being taken into exile to Babylon.
en.B: This message came to Jeremiah from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} after Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had set him free at Ramah. Nebuzaradan had found him there bound in chains, among all the captives from Jerusalem and Judah who were being taken into exile in Babylon.
en.R: This is the message {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave Jeremiah after Nebuzaradan, the commander of the royal guard, set him free at Ramah. Jeremiah had been brought there in chains along with all the captives from Jerusalem and Judah who were being taken away to Babylon.

es.L: La palabra que vino a Jeremías de parte {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, después que Nabuzaradán, jefe de la guardia, lo dejó libre en Ramá, cuando lo tomó, estando él atado con cadenas en medio de todos los cautivos de Jerusalén y de Judá que eran llevados al destierro a Babilonia.
es.B: Este mensaje vino a Jeremías de parte {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} después de que Nabuzaradán, capitán de la guardia, lo dejó en libertad en Ramá. Nabuzaradán lo había encontrado allí atado con cadenas, entre todos los cautivos de Jerusalén y de Judá que eran llevados al destierro en Babilonia.
es.R: Este es el mensaje que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dio a Jeremías después de que Nabuzaradán, el comandante de la guardia real, lo dejó libre en Ramá. Habían llevado allí a Jeremías encadenado, junto con todos los cautivos de Jerusalén y de Judá que eran llevados a Babilonia.

fr.L: La parole qui fut adressée à Jérémie de la part {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, après que Nebouzaradân, chef des gardes, l’eut laissé partir de Rama, quand il le prit, alors qu’il [était] lié de chaînes au milieu de tous les déportés de Jérusalem et de Juda qu’on emmenait en exil à Babylone.
fr.B: Ce message fut adressé à Jérémie par {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} après que Nebouzaradân, le commandant de la garde, l’eut remis en liberté à Rama. Nebouzaradân l’y avait trouvé lié de chaînes, parmi tous les captifs de Jérusalem et de Juda qu’on emmenait en exil à Babylone.
fr.R: Voici le message que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a donné à Jérémie après que Nebouzaradân, le chef de la garde royale, l’a libéré à Rama. On avait amené Jérémie là-bas enchaîné, avec tous les captifs de Jérusalem et de Juda qu’on emmenait à Babylone.

sw.L: Neno lililomjia Yeremia kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, baada ya Nebuzaradani mkuu wa walinzi kumwachilia kutoka Rama, alipomchukua, naye [alikuwa] amefungwa kwa minyororo katikati ya mateka wote wa Yerusalemu na Yuda waliokuwa wakihamishwa kwenda Babeli.
sw.B: Ujumbe huu ulimjia Yeremia kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} baada ya Nebuzaradani kamanda wa walinzi kumwachilia huru huko Rama. Nebuzaradani alikuwa amemkuta huko amefungwa kwa minyororo, kati ya mateka wote wa Yerusalemu na Yuda waliokuwa wakichukuliwa uhamishoni Babeli.
sw.R: Huu ndio ujumbe ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimpa Yeremia baada ya Nebuzaradani, kamanda wa walinzi wa mfalme, kumwachilia huru huko Rama. Yeremia alikuwa ameletwa huko akiwa amefungwa minyororo pamoja na mateka wote wa Yerusalemu na Yuda waliokuwa wakipelekwa Babeli.

vi.L: Lời từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến với Giê-rê-mi, sau khi Nê-bu-xa-a-đan, quan chỉ huy vệ binh, đã thả ông ra từ Ra-ma, khi hắn bắt được ông đang bị xiềng xích giữa tất cả những người lưu đày của Giê-ru-sa-lem và Giu-đa, là những người đang bị đem đi lưu đày sang Ba-by-lôn.
vi.B: Sứ điệp này từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến với Giê-rê-mi sau khi Nê-bu-xa-a-đan, quan chỉ huy đội cận vệ, đã trả tự do cho ông tại Ra-ma. Nê-bu-xa-a-đan đã thấy ông bị xiềng xích tại đó, giữa tất cả những người bị bắt từ Giê-ru-sa-lem và Giu-đa đang bị đem đi lưu đày sang Ba-by-lôn.
vi.R: Đây là sứ điệp {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban cho Giê-rê-mi sau khi Nê-bu-xa-a-đan, người chỉ huy đội cận vệ hoàng gia, trả tự do cho ông tại Ra-ma. Giê-rê-mi đã bị xiềng xích đưa đến đó cùng với tất cả những người bị bắt từ Giê-ru-sa-lem và Giu-đa đang bị đem đi Ba-by-lôn.

ko.L: 경호대장 느부사라단이 예레미야를 라마에서 풀어 준 뒤에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께로부터 예레미야에게 임한 말씀이다. 그가 그를 데려올 때, 그는 바빌론으로 사로잡혀 가는 예루살렘과 유다의 모든 포로 가운데서 사슬에 묶여 [있었다].
ko.B: 이것은 경호대장 느부사라단이 라마에서 예레미야를 풀어 준 뒤에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 예레미야에게 주신 말씀이다. 느부사라단이 그를 찾았을 때, 그는 바빌론으로 사로잡혀 가는 예루살렘과 유다의 모든 포로 가운데서 사슬에 묶여 있었다.
ko.R: 왕의 경호대장 느부사라단이 라마에서 예레미야를 풀어 준 뒤에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 예레미야에게 주신 말씀은 이러하다. 예레미야는 바빌론으로 끌려가는 예루살렘과 유다의 모든 포로와 함께 사슬에 묶여 그곳에 와 있었다.

pt.L: A palavra que veio a Jeremias da parte {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, depois que Nebuzaradã, o chefe da guarda, o soltou em Ramá, quando o tomou, e ele [estava] preso com correntes no meio de todos os exilados de Jerusalém e de Judá que estavam sendo levados para o exílio na Babilônia.
pt.B: Esta mensagem veio a Jeremias da parte {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} depois que Nebuzaradã, capitão da guarda, o libertou em Ramá. Nebuzaradã o tinha encontrado ali preso com correntes, no meio de todos os cativos de Jerusalém e de Judá que estavam sendo levados para o exílio na Babilônia.
pt.R: Esta é a mensagem que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} deu a Jeremias depois que Nebuzaradã, o comandante da guarda real, o libertou em Ramá. Jeremias tinha sido levado para lá com correntes, junto com todos os prisioneiros de Jerusalém e de Judá que estavam sendo levados para a Babilônia.

am.L: የዘበኞቹ አለቃ ናቡዘረዳን ከራማ ከለቀቀው በኋላ {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣው ቃል ይህ ነው፤ በወሰደውም ጊዜ እርሱ ወደ ባቢሎን በሚፈልሱት በኢየሩሳሌምና በይሁዳ ምርኮኞች ሁሉ መካከል በሰንሰለት ታስሮ ነበረ።
am.B: የዘበኞቹ አለቃ ናቡዘረዳን ኤርምያስን በራማ ነጻ ከለቀቀው በኋላ ይህ ቃል {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} ወደ ኤርምያስ መጣ። ናቡዘረዳን ባገኘው ጊዜ ኤርምያስ ወደ ባቢሎን ተማርከው በሚወሰዱት በኢየሩሳሌምና በይሁዳ ምርኮኞች ሁሉ መካከል በሰንሰለት ታስሮ ነበር።
am.R: የንጉሡ ዘበኞች አዛዥ ናቡዘረዳን ኤርምያስን በራማ ነጻ ከለቀቀው በኋላ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለኤርምያስ የሰጠው መልእክት ይህ ነው። ኤርምያስ ወደ ባቢሎን ተማርከው ከሚወሰዱት ከኢየሩሳሌምና ከይሁዳ ምርኮኞች ሁሉ ጋር በሰንሰለት ታስሮ ወደዚያ ተወስዶ ነበር።

hi.L: वह वचन जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की ओर से यिर्मयाह के पास पहुँचा, जब अंगरक्षकों के प्रधान नबूज़रदान ने उसे रामा से छोड़ दिया था, जब उसने उसे ले लिया, और वह यरूशलेम और यहूदा के उन सब बंधुओं के बीच ज़ंजीरों में बँधा [था] जो बाबुल को निर्वासित किए जा रहे थे।
hi.B: यह वचन {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की ओर से यिर्मयाह के पास तब पहुँचा जब अंगरक्षकों के प्रधान नबूज़रदान ने उसे रामा में छोड़ दिया था। नबूज़रदान ने उसे वहाँ यरूशलेम और यहूदा के उन सब बंदियों के बीच ज़ंजीरों में बँधा पाया था जो निर्वासन में बाबुल ले जाए जा रहे थे।
hi.R: यह वह संदेश है जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने यिर्मयाह को तब दिया जब राजा के अंगरक्षकों के सेनापति नबूज़रदान ने उसे रामा में छोड़ दिया। यिर्मयाह को ज़ंजीरों में बाँधकर वहाँ लाया गया था। उसके साथ यरूशलेम और यहूदा के वे सब बंदी थे जिन्हें बाबुल ले जाया जा रहा था।

ru.L: Слово, которое было к Иеремии от {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, после того как Навузардан, начальник телохранителей, отпустил его из Рамы, когда взял его, а он [был] скован цепями среди всех пленников Иерусалима и Иуды, уводимых в плен в Вавилон.
ru.B: Вот слово, с которым {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} обратился к Иеремии после того, как Навузардан, начальник стражи, освободил его в Раме. Навузардан нашёл его там скованным цепями среди всех пленников из Иерусалима и Иуды, которых уводили в изгнание в Вавилон.
ru.R: Вот слово, которое {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} дал Иеремии после того, как Навузардан, командир царской стражи, освободил его в Раме. Иеремию привели туда в цепях вместе со всеми пленниками из Иерусалима и Иуды, которых уводили в Вавилон.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}からエレミヤに臨んだ言葉。それは、護衛隊長ネブザルアダンが彼をラマから去らせた後のことである。[ネブザルアダンが]彼を連れて来たとき、彼は鎖につながれて、バビロンへ捕らえ移されるエルサレムとユダのすべての捕囚の民の中にいた。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}からエレミヤに臨んだ言葉。それは、護衛隊長ネブザルアダンがラマで彼を釈放した後のことである。ネブザルアダンがそこで見つけたとき、エレミヤは鎖につながれて、バビロンへ捕囚として連れ去られるエルサレムとユダのすべての捕虜の中にいた。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がエレミヤに語られたお告げは、次のとおりです。それは、王の護衛隊の隊長ネブザルアダンが、ラマでエレミヤを自由にした後のことでした。エレミヤは鎖につながれて、バビロンへ連れて行かれるエルサレムとユダのすべての捕虜と一緒に、そこまで連れて来られていたのです。

decisions.choice: the heading stands over the account that follows; no message from the LORD is given until 42:7
alternatives: the heading introduces the captain's words in verses 2-3
the heading introduces a message given later, in 42:7
decisions.reason: This is the heading Jeremiah uses before a message from the LORD (7:1; 21:1), but here no message follows. The captain speaks in verses 2-5 and the story runs on, and the next word from the LORD comes in 42:7. The heading may introduce the whole account of chapters 40-44, which ends with the LORD's words through Jeremiah in Egypt. Or it may point to the captain's words in verses 2-3, which repeat what the LORD had said through Jeremiah. The text does not say which.

decisions.choice: Ramah: a town of Benjamin a few miles north of Jerusalem, where the captives were gathered
decisions.reason: Ramah lay on the road north from Jerusalem. The Babylonians seem to have assembled the captives there before the long march to Babylon. It is the Ramah where Rachel is heard weeping for her children who are gone (31:15).

decisions.choice: a second account of Jeremiah's release, beside 39:11-14
decisions.reason: In 39:11-14 Nebuchadrezzar orders Jeremiah to be looked after, and the Babylonian officers take him from the courtyard of the guard and entrust him to Gedaliah. Here he is found in chains among the captives at Ramah. He may have been set free in Jerusalem and then swept up with the other captives, or the two passages may tell the same release from two different reports. Either way, both say he was freed by the Babylonians and went to Gedaliah.

decisions.choice: the chief of the guard: the commander of the king's bodyguard
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 25:8. The title is literally "chief of the slaughterers" or "of the cooks", an old court title for the officer in charge of the royal guard (Genesis 37:36; Jeremiah 39:9).

decisions.choice: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD (L), with no "saying" and no colon; This message came to Jeremiah from the LORD (B); This is the message the LORD gave Jeremiah (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for this heading throughout Jeremiah. Here the Hebrew has no "saying" and no message follows directly, so Literal leaves out "saying", and no level ends the heading with a colon. Balanced and Readable put the rest of the verse in a second sentence.

decisions.choice: chief of the guard (Literal); captain of the guard (Balanced); commander of the royal guard (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 25:8. Balanced names Nebuzaradan again in its second sentence to make clear who found Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: La palabra que vino a Jeremías de parte del SEÑOR (L), without "diciendo" or a colon; Este mensaje vino ... (B); Este es el mensaje que el SEÑOR le dio a Jeremías (R)
decisions.reason: The heading formula set for Jeremiah. The message itself does not follow at once; the story of Jeremiah's release comes first.

decisions.choice: jefe de la guardia (L); capitán de la guardia (B); comandante de la guardia real (R)
decisions.reason: The title as published 2 Kings 25:8.

decisions.choice: the heading formula without "kusema" and without a colon
decisions.reason: As the English: the heading stands over the account that follows, and no message is quoted after it.

decisions.choice: "chef des gardes" (L), "le commandant de la garde" (B), "le chef de la garde (royale)" (R)
decisions.reason: Nebuzaradan’s title as the published French of 2 Kings 25:8.

decisions.choice: no "disant :" and no colon at Literal
decisions.reason: The Hebrew heading has no "saying" here, and no message follows until 42:7; the French heading ends with a full stop, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Lời từ CHÚA đến với Giê-rê-mi (L), with no "rằng"
alternatives: Lời từ CHÚA đến với Giê-rê-mi rằng:
decisions.reason: The heading has no "saying" here and stands over the whole account; no message follows until 42:7, so Literal leaves out "rằng" and the colon, as the English does.

decisions.choice: The heading "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께로부터 예레미야에게 임한 말씀" (L), "...주신 말씀이다" (B), "...주신 말씀은 이러하다" (R), as set at 35:1
decisions.reason: The meaning decision notes that no word from the LORD follows until 42:7; Korean keeps the heading formula as the English does.

decisions.choice: "경호대장" at every level, with "왕의" added at R
decisions.reason: The form published in 2 Kings 25:8-20 for Nebuzaradan, reused through Jeremiah 39-52.

decisions.choice: the heading of 21:1, with no colon; Nebuzaradã, o chefe da guarda (L), capitão da guarda (B), o comandante da guarda real (R); Ramá
decisions.reason: The heading keeps the wording 21:1 sets for it, but, as in the English, it ends without "dizendo" and without a colon, since no message follows at once (m1). The officer's title keeps the words 2 Kings 25:8 gives it at each level (m4), with "real" at Readable as the English says "royal guard" here and 41:10 has it. "Ramá" as Matthew 2:18 and 31:15 (m2).

decisions.choice: वह वचन जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की ओर से यिर्मयाह के पास पहुँचा (L); यह संदेश ... पहुँचा (B); यह वह संदेश है जो ... ने यिर्मयाह को दिया (R)
decisions.reason: The heading form of the word-of-the-LORD formula, with the same verb (पहुँचा) as the note's formula and no word for "saying", as the English. The message itself does not begin until 42:7.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Hindi
decisions.reason: The English marks God's pronouns with the deity_pronoun setting in this chapter. Devanagari has no capital letters, so the Hindi has no such spans; respect for God comes from the honorific third person (वे, उनका). Recorded once for this file.

decisions.choice: "Слово, которое было к Иеремии от ГОСПОДА" (L); "Вот слово, с которым ГОСПОДЬ обратился к Иеремии" (B); "Вот слово, которое ГОСПОДЬ дал Иеремии" (R)
decisions.reason: The heading "the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD", worded at each level after the Prophets note's formula for "the word of the LORD came to X" ("было слово ... к" at Literal, "обратился к" at Balanced, "дал ... слово" at Readable). No message follows at once (m1), so there is no colon.

decisions.choice: "Рама"
decisions.reason: The town of Benjamin (m2), in the form 1 Kings 15:17 uses in this translation.

decisions.choice: a Babylonian officer repeats the prophet's message
decisions.reason: The captain speaks of the LORD as Jeremiah's God and says what Jeremiah had said for forty years: the disaster came from the LORD because of Judah's sin. He may have heard Jeremiah's message from deserters or informers (38:19; 39:9), and he may only be using it to explain events. Either way, a foreign officer now confirms the word that Judah's own kings and leaders had refused.

decisions.choice: spoke this disaster: declared that this disaster would come
decisions.reason: To "speak a disaster" against a place is to announce it as a coming judgment (11:17; 19:15; 35:17; 36:31).

decisions.choice: this place: Jerusalem and the land of Judah
decisions.reason: As often in Jeremiah (7:3; 19:3), "this place" is the city and the land around it.

decisions.choice: took Jeremiah aside (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only that he "took" Jeremiah. Balanced and Readable add "aside" to show that he singled Jeremiah out from the captives in order to speak to him.

decisions.choice: said he would bring this disaster on this place (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what it means to "speak" a disaster (m2).

decisions.choice: ông (Nebuzaradan to Jeremiah)
decisions.reason: The Babylonian commander treats the prophet with respect, by his king's order (39:12): "ông".

decisions.choice: Nebuzaradan speaks to Jeremiah in 하오체 and speaks of Jeremiah's God with "-시-"
decisions.reason: A conquering officer speaking with respect to a prophet his king protects (39:12); 하오체 is the register Gedaliah uses with the commanders in 2 Kings 25:24.

decisions.choice: você (the Babylonian officer to Jeremiah); o seu Deus
decisions.reason: The officer speaks to Jeremiah as people speak to each other, with "você", so "your God" is "o seu Deus"; the context makes plain whose God is meant (m1).

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span in the Amharic.
decisions.reason: Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change in Amharic (docs/amharic-style.md section 7).

decisions.choice: तुम to Jeremiah
decisions.reason: The Babylonian commander speaks to a prisoner he is releasing; he is kind but in command, so he says तुम, as officers do to those under them elsewhere in these books.

decisions.choice: "изрёк это бедствие на это место"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "spoke" with the disaster as its object; it means that he declared it would come (m2), which Balanced and Readable say.

decisions.choice: The Babylonian captain speaks to the prisoner plainly, as a superior (あなた, plain verbs), but with light respect forms for Jeremiah's God (語られた, 告げておられた).
decisions.reason: m1: a foreign officer repeats the prophet's message with respect; the respect form follows the speaker's courtesy to the God he names.

am.B: አሁንም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይህን አመጣው፤ እንደ ተናገረውም አደረገ፤ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ላይ ኃጢአት ሠርታችኋል፤ ቃሉንም አልታዘዛችሁም። ይህ የደረሰባችሁ ስለዚህ ነው።
am.R: አሁንም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይህን አድርጎታል። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አደርጋለሁ ያለውን ልክ አደረገ። ይህ ሁሉ የደረሰባችሁ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ላይ ኃጢአት ስለ ሠራችሁና ስላልታዘዛችሁት ነው።

hi.L: और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने [उसे] ला दिया है, और जैसा उन्होंने कहा था वैसा ही किया है, क्योंकि तुमने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के विरुद्ध पाप किया और उनकी बात नहीं सुनी, और यह बात तुम पर आ पड़ी है।

hi.R: अब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने यह कर दिखाया है। उन्होंने ठीक वही किया है जो उन्होंने कहा था कि वे करेंगे। यह सब तुम लोगों पर इसलिए आया है क्योंकि तुमने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के विरुद्ध पाप किया और उनकी बात नहीं मानी।

ru.B: И вот {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} навёл его и сделал то, что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сказал, потому что вы согрешили против {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} и не слушались {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} голоса. Вот почему это случилось с вами.

ja.B: 今、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はそれを起こし、語られたとおりに行われた。あなたがたが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に対して罪を犯し、その声に聞き従わなかったからだ。それで、このことがあなたがたに起こったのだ。

decisions.choice: "you" is plural: the people of Judah, not Jeremiah alone
decisions.reason: The captain speaks to Jeremiah, but the verbs and pronouns are plural. He is speaking of Judah as a whole, with Jeremiah as one of its people. He does not accuse Jeremiah himself, who had warned them.

decisions.choice: the captain echoes Jeremiah's own words
decisions.reason: "Because you sinned against the LORD and did not obey his voice ... this disaster has happened to you" is how Jeremiah himself explains the fall of Judah (32:23; 44:23). The captain's words sound like a summary of the prophet's message.

decisions.choice: listen to his voice: obey him
decisions.reason: To "listen to the voice" of someone means to do what they say (7:23; 11:4).

decisions.choice: the thing with "the", as the margin reads
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew text has "thing" without the article; the scribes' marginal reading adds "the" ("this thing"). The meaning is the same, and the marginal reading is followed.

decisions.choice: did not obey his voice (Balanced); did not obey him (Readable); you people (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use "obey" for the idiom (m3). Readable says "you people" to show that "you" is plural (m1) and puts the reason after the result.

decisions.choice: plural_you
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "you" is plural: Nebuzaradan speaks of Jeremiah's people as a whole, not of Jeremiah himself.

decisions.reason: The Hebrew "you" is plural, the people of Judah, not Jeremiah alone; Swahili shows the plural in the verbs without adding a word.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֞ה הִנֵּ֧ה פִתַּחְתִּ֣יךָ הַיּ֗וֹם מִֽן־הָאזִקִּים֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־יָדֶךָ֒ אִם־ט֨וֹב בְּעֵינֶ֜יךָ לָב֧וֹא אִתִּ֣י בָבֶ֗ל בֹּ֚א וְאָשִׂ֤ים אֶת־עֵינִי֙ עָלֶ֔יךָ וְאִם־רַ֧ע בְּעֵינֶ֛יךָ לָבֽוֹא־אִתִּ֥י בָבֶ֖ל חֲדָ֑ל רְאֵה֙ כָּל־הָאָ֣רֶץ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ אֶל־ט֨וֹב וְאֶל־הַיָּשָׁ֧ר בְּעֵינֶ֛יךָ לָלֶ֥כֶת שָׁ֖מָּה לֵֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And now, here, I have released you today from the chains which [are] on your hand. If [it is] good in your eyes to come with me [to] Babylon, come, and I will set my eye on you; and if [it is] bad in your eyes to come with me [to] Babylon, refrain. See, all the land [is] before you; to the good and to the right in your eyes to go, there go.

en.L: And now, look, I release you today from the chains that [are] on your hand. If it [is] good in your eyes to come with me [to] Babylon, come, and I will set my eye on you; but if it [is] bad in your eyes to come with me [to] Babylon, refrain. See, the whole land [is] before you; wherever [it is] good and right in your eyes to go, go there."
en.B: But now, today I am setting you free from the chains on your wrists. If you would like to come with me to Babylon, come, and I will look after you. But if you would rather not come with me to Babylon, then stay. See, the whole land lies open before you. Go wherever you think it good and right to go."
en.R: But today I am taking the chains off your wrists and setting you free. If you want to come with me to Babylon, then come. I will take good care of you. But if you do not want to come with me to Babylon, you do not have to. Look, the whole country is open to you. Go wherever you think is best."

es.L: Y ahora, mira, yo te suelto hoy de las cadenas que [están] sobre tu mano. Si [es] bueno a tus ojos venir conmigo [a] Babilonia, ven, y yo pondré mis ojos sobre ti; pero si [es] malo a tus ojos venir conmigo [a] Babilonia, déjalo. Mira, toda la tierra [está] delante de ti; adonde [sea] bueno y recto a tus ojos ir, ve allá».
es.B: Pero ahora, hoy te libro de las cadenas que tienes en las muñecas. Si quieres venir conmigo a Babilonia, ven, y yo cuidaré de ti. Pero si prefieres no venir conmigo a Babilonia, quédate. Mira, toda la tierra está abierta delante de ti. Ve adonde te parezca bueno y recto ir».
es.R: Pero hoy te quito las cadenas de las muñecas y te dejo libre. Si quieres venir conmigo a Babilonia, ven. Yo te cuidaré bien. Pero si no quieres venir conmigo a Babilonia, no tienes que hacerlo. Mira, todo el país está abierto para ti. Ve adonde te parezca mejor».

fr.L: Et maintenant, voici, je te délie aujourd’hui des chaînes qui [sont] sur ta main. S’il [est] bon à tes yeux de venir avec moi [à] Babylone, viens, et je poserai mon œil sur toi ; mais s’il [est] mauvais à tes yeux de venir avec moi [à] Babylone, abstiens-toi. Vois, tout le pays [est] devant toi ; là où il [est] bon et droit à tes yeux d’aller, vas-y. »
fr.B: Mais maintenant, je te libère aujourd’hui des chaînes que tu as aux poignets. S’il te plaît de venir avec moi à Babylone, viens, et je veillerai sur toi. Mais si tu préfères ne pas venir avec moi à Babylone, reste. Vois, tout le pays s’ouvre devant toi. Va où il te semble bon et juste d’aller. »
fr.R: Mais aujourd’hui, je t’enlève les chaînes des poignets et je te rends la liberté. Si tu veux venir avec moi à Babylone, viens. Je prendrai bien soin de toi. Mais si tu ne veux pas venir avec moi à Babylone, tu n’es pas obligé. Regarde, tout le pays t’est ouvert. Va où tu penses que c’est le mieux. »

sw.L: Na sasa, tazama, ninakufungua leo minyororo iliyo mkononi mwako. Ikiwa ni vema machoni pako kuja pamoja nami [hata] Babeli, njoo, nami nitaliweka jicho langu juu yako; lakini ikiwa ni vibaya machoni pako kuja pamoja nami [hata] Babeli, acha. Tazama, nchi yote iko mbele yako; mahali popote palipo pema na pa haki machoni pako kwenda, nenda huko."
sw.B: Lakini sasa, leo ninakufungua minyororo iliyo mikononi mwako. Ukipenda kuja pamoja nami Babeli, njoo, nami nitakutunza. Lakini usipopenda kuja pamoja nami Babeli, basi kaa. Tazama, nchi yote iko wazi mbele yako. Nenda popote unapoona ni vema na haki kwenda."
sw.R: Lakini leo ninakuondolea minyororo mikononi mwako na kukuacha huru. Ukitaka kuja pamoja nami Babeli, basi njoo. Nitakutunza vizuri. Lakini usipotaka kuja pamoja nami Babeli, si lazima uje. Tazama, nchi yote iko wazi kwako. Nenda popote unapoona ni bora."

vi.L: Và bây giờ, này, hôm nay ta tháo cho ông khỏi xiềng xích ở trên tay ông. Nếu ông thấy tốt mà đi với ta [sang] Ba-by-lôn, hãy đến, ta sẽ để mắt trông nom ông; nhưng nếu ông thấy không tốt mà đi với ta [sang] Ba-by-lôn, thì thôi. Hãy xem, cả xứ ở trước mặt ông; ông thấy đâu là tốt và phải để đi, thì hãy đi đến đó."
vi.B: Nhưng bây giờ, hôm nay ta tháo xiềng xích khỏi cổ tay ông. Nếu ông muốn đi với ta sang Ba-by-lôn thì hãy đến, ta sẽ chăm sóc ông. Còn nếu ông không muốn đi với ta sang Ba-by-lôn thì cứ ở lại. Hãy xem, cả xứ đang mở rộng trước mặt ông. Ông thấy đâu là tốt và phải thì hãy đi đến đó."
vi.R: Nhưng hôm nay ta tháo xiềng xích khỏi cổ tay ông và trả tự do cho ông. Nếu ông muốn đi với ta sang Ba-by-lôn thì hãy đi. Ta sẽ chăm sóc ông chu đáo. Còn nếu ông không muốn đi với ta sang Ba-by-lôn thì cũng không sao. Hãy xem, cả xứ đều mở rộng cho ông. Ông thấy đâu tốt nhất thì hãy đi đến đó."

ko.L: 그리고 이제 보시오, 내가 오늘 당신의 손에 [있는] 사슬에서 당신을 풀어 주오. 만일 나와 함께 바빌론으로 가는 것이 당신의 눈에 좋으면 오시오. 내가 당신에게 내 눈을 두겠소. 그러나 만일 나와 함께 바빌론으로 가는 것이 당신의 눈에 나쁘면 그만두시오. 보시오, 온 땅이 당신 앞에 [있소]. 당신의 눈에 좋고 옳은 곳으로 가시오."
ko.B: 이제 내가 오늘 당신의 손목에 채운 사슬을 풀어 당신을 놓아주겠소. 나와 함께 바빌론으로 가고 싶으면 갑시다. 내가 당신을 잘 돌보아 주겠소. 그러나 나와 함께 바빌론으로 가고 싶지 않으면 여기에 머무르시오. 보시오, 온 땅이 당신 앞에 열려 있소. 당신이 좋고 옳다고 생각하는 곳으로 가시오."
ko.R: 오늘 나는 당신의 손목에서 사슬을 풀고 당신을 놓아주겠소. 나와 함께 바빌론으로 가고 싶으면 갑시다. 내가 당신을 잘 돌보아 주겠소. 그러나 나와 함께 바빌론으로 가고 싶지 않으면 가지 않아도 되오. 보시오, 이 온 나라가 당신에게 열려 있소. 당신이 가장 좋다고 생각하는 곳으로 가시오."

pt.L: E agora, eis que eu o solto hoje das correntes que [estão] na sua mão. Se [é] bom aos seus olhos vir comigo [para a] Babilônia, venha, e porei os meus olhos sobre você; mas, se [é] mau aos seus olhos vir comigo [para a] Babilônia, deixe de vir. Veja, toda a terra [está] diante de você; para onde [for] bom e reto aos seus olhos ir, vá para lá."
pt.B: Mas agora, hoje eu o liberto das correntes dos seus pulsos. Se você quiser vir comigo para a Babilônia, venha, e eu cuidarei de você. Mas, se preferir não vir comigo para a Babilônia, fique. Veja, toda a terra está aberta diante de você. Vá aonde achar bom e certo ir."
pt.R: Mas hoje eu vou tirar as correntes dos seus pulsos e deixar você livre. Se você quiser vir comigo para a Babilônia, venha. Eu vou cuidar bem de você. Mas, se não quiser vir comigo para a Babilônia, não precisa vir. Veja, todo o país está aberto para você. Vá aonde achar melhor."

am.L: አሁንም እነሆ፣ ዛሬ በእጅህ ካለው ሰንሰለት እፈታሃለሁ። ከእኔ ጋር ወደ ባቢሎን መምጣት በዓይንህ መልካም ቢሆን ና፤ ዓይኔንም በአንተ ላይ አደርጋለሁ፤ ከእኔ ጋር ወደ ባቢሎን መምጣት ግን በዓይንህ ክፉ ቢሆን ተው። እይ፤ ምድሪቱ ሁሉ በፊትህ ናት፤ ትሄድ ዘንድ በዓይንህ መልካምና ቅን ወደ ሆነው ስፍራ ወደዚያ ሂድ።»
am.B: አሁን ግን ዛሬ በእጆችህ ላይ ካለው ሰንሰለት ነጻ አወጣሃለሁ። ከእኔ ጋር ወደ ባቢሎን መምጣት ብትፈልግ ና፤ እኔም እንከባከብሃለሁ። ከእኔ ጋር ወደ ባቢሎን መምጣት ባትፈልግ ግን እዚሁ ቆይ። ተመልከት፤ ምድሪቱ ሁሉ በፊትህ ክፍት ናት። መልካምና ትክክል ነው ብለህ ወደምታስበው ስፍራ ሂድ።»
am.R: ዛሬ ግን ሰንሰለቱን ከእጆችህ አውልቄ ነጻ እለቅቅሃለሁ። ከእኔ ጋር ወደ ባቢሎን መምጣት ብትፈልግ ና። በደንብ እንከባከብሃለሁ። ከእኔ ጋር ወደ ባቢሎን መምጣት ባትፈልግ ግን የግድ አይደለም። ተመልከት፤ አገሩ ሁሉ ለአንተ ክፍት ነው። የሚሻልህ ወደ መሰለህ ስፍራ ሂድ።»

hi.L: और अब, देखो, मैं आज तुम्हें उन ज़ंजीरों से छोड़ता हूँ जो तुम्हारे हाथ पर [हैं]। यदि मेरे साथ बाबुल चलना तुम्हारी आँखों में अच्छा [लगे], तो आओ, और मैं तुम पर अपनी आँख रखूँगा; पर यदि मेरे साथ बाबुल चलना तुम्हारी आँखों में बुरा [लगे], तो रुक जाओ। देखो, सारा देश तुम्हारे सामने [है]; जहाँ जाना तुम्हारी आँखों में अच्छा और ठीक [लगे], वहीं जाओ।"
hi.B: पर आज मैं तुम्हें तुम्हारी कलाइयों की ज़ंजीरों से छुड़ा रहा हूँ। यदि तुम मेरे साथ बाबुल चलना चाहो, तो चलो, और मैं तुम्हारी देखभाल करूँगा। पर यदि तुम मेरे साथ बाबुल न चलना चाहो, तो यहीं रहो। देखो, सारा देश तुम्हारे सामने खुला है। जहाँ जाना तुम्हें अच्छा और ठीक लगे, वहीं चले जाओ।"
hi.R: पर आज मैं तुम्हारी कलाइयों से ज़ंजीरें उतारकर तुम्हें छोड़ रहा हूँ। अगर तुम मेरे साथ बाबुल चलना चाहते हो, तो चलो। मैं तुम्हारा अच्छी तरह ध्यान रखूँगा। पर अगर तुम मेरे साथ बाबुल नहीं आना चाहते, तो कोई बात नहीं। देखो, सारा देश तुम्हारे सामने है। जहाँ तुम्हें सबसे अच्छा लगे, वहीं चले जाओ।"

ru.L: А теперь вот, я освобождаю тебя сегодня от цепей, которые на твоей руке. Если хорошо в твоих глазах идти со мной [в] Вавилон, иди, и я обращу на тебя свой глаз; а если плохо в твоих глазах идти со мной [в] Вавилон, не ходи. Смотри, вся земля перед тобой; куда хорошо и правильно в твоих глазах идти, туда иди.»
ru.B: Но сегодня я освобождаю тебя от цепей на твоих запястьях. Если хочешь идти со мной в Вавилон, иди, и я позабочусь о тебе. А если не хочешь идти со мной в Вавилон, оставайся. Смотри, вся страна открыта перед тобой. Иди туда, куда сочтёшь хорошим и правильным.»
ru.R: Но сегодня я снимаю цепи с твоих рук и отпускаю тебя. Если хочешь пойти со мной в Вавилон, иди. Я хорошо позабочусь о тебе. Но если не хочешь идти со мной в Вавилон, ты не обязан. Смотри, вся страна открыта перед тобой. Иди, куда считаешь лучше.»

ja.L: そして今、見なさい、わたしは今日、あなたの手にある鎖からあなたを解く。もしわたしと共にバビロンへ来ることがあなたの目に良いなら、来るがよい。わたしはあなたにわたしの目を注ごう。しかし、もしわたしと共にバビロンへ来ることがあなたの目に悪いなら、やめておけ。見よ、全地はあなたの前にある。あなたの目に良く、正しいと思われる所へ行くがよい。そこへ行け。」
ja.B: しかし今日、わたしはあなたの手首の鎖を解いて、あなたを自由にする。もしわたしと共にバビロンへ来たいなら、来なさい。あなたの面倒を見よう。しかし、わたしと共にバビロンへ来たくないなら、とどまりなさい。見なさい、この地全体があなたの前に開かれている。良いと思い、正しいと思う所へ行きなさい。」
ja.R: しかし今日、わたしはあなたの手首から鎖を外し、あなたを自由にする。わたしと一緒にバビロンへ来たいなら、来なさい。あなたのことは、わたしがよく世話をしよう。しかし、わたしと一緒にバビロンへ来たくないなら、来なくてもよい。見なさい、この国全体が、あなたのために開かれている。いちばん良いと思う所へ行きなさい。」

decisions.choice: I release you today: the release takes effect as he speaks
decisions.reason: The verb has the form of a completed act, used for a declaration that is done by being said. With "today" it means that Jeremiah is free from this moment.

decisions.choice: good in your eyes ... bad in your eyes: if you want ... if you do not want
decisions.reason: "Good in your eyes" means "what seems good to you", what you wish (26:14). "Bad in your eyes" is the opposite: if you would rather not.

decisions.choice: I will set my eye on you: I will look after you
decisions.reason: To set one's eye on someone is to watch over them for their good, as Nebuchadrezzar had ordered for Jeremiah in 39:12 and as the LORD promises the exiles in 24:6.

decisions.choice: the whole land is before you: you may live wherever you choose
decisions.reason: The same words give Lot a free choice of land in Genesis 13:9, and Abimelech uses them to Abraham in Genesis 20:15. The captain gives Jeremiah the freedom of the country.

decisions.choice: hand (Literal); wrists (Balanced, Readable); refrain (Literal); stay (Balanced); you do not have to (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "hand", singular; Balanced and Readable say where chains are worn. Its verb for "do not come" means "leave off" or "refrain", which Literal keeps.

decisions.choice: the quotation closes here and opens again in verse 5
decisions.reason: The captain's speech goes on in verse 5, but verse 5 begins with a remark by the narrator. The quotation is closed here and opened again after that remark.

decisions.choice: "ni vema machoni pako", "nitaliweka jicho langu juu yako" (L); "Ukipenda", "nitakutunza" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew pictures of the eyes; Balanced and Readable say "if you want" and "I will look after you".

decisions.choice: "당신의 눈에 좋으면" and "내가 당신에게 내 눈을 두겠소" (L); "가고 싶으면", "잘 돌보아 주겠소" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew pictures of the eye; the meaning decisions give their sense, which Balanced and Readable say.

decisions.choice: bom aos seus olhos (L); porei os meus olhos sobre você (L), cuidarei de você (B, R); toda a terra está diante de você
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew idioms (m2, m3), as the English does, and Balanced and Readable give their sense; "pôr os olhos sobre" is the phrase of 39:12. The officer gives Jeremiah the free choice of Genesis 13:9 (m4), "toda a terra está diante de você".

decisions.choice: हाथ (L), कलाइयों (B, R); रुक जाओ (L), यहीं रहो (B), कोई बात नहीं (R)
decisions.reason: As the English levels: Literal keeps "on your hand" and "refrain"; Balanced and Readable say where chains are worn and what refraining means here.

decisions.choice: "на твоей руке" (L), "на твоих запястьях" (B), "с твоих рук" (R); "хорошо / плохо в твоих глазах" (L), "хочешь / не хочешь" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the singular "hand" and the idiom of the eyes (m2); Balanced and Readable say where chains are worn and what the idiom means.

decisions.choice: hinneh "見なさい" (L), left out (B, R) as the English; 'asim 'et 'eini "わたしの目を注ごう" (L), "面倒を見よう" (B), "よく世話をしよう" (R); re'eh "見よ" (L), "見なさい" (B, R).
decisions.reason: m3; the JER convention for hinneh and re'eh, used here in a human speaker's mouth.

decisions.choice: The captain's permissions in plain, kindly forms: "来るがよい / やめておけ / 行け" (L), "来なさい / とどまりなさい / 行きなさい" (B, R).
decisions.reason: A high officer speaking kindly to a released prisoner: neither harsh orders nor polite requests.

source.text: וְעוֹדֶ֣נּוּ לֹֽא־יָשׁ֗וּב וְשֻׁ֡בָה אֶל־גְּדַלְיָ֣ה בֶן־אֲחִיקָ֣ם בֶּן־שָׁפָ֡ן אֲשֶׁר֩ הִפְקִ֨יד מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֜ל בְּעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה וְשֵׁ֤ב אִתּוֹ֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ הָעָ֔ם א֠וֹ אֶל־כָּל־הַיָּשָׁ֧ר בְּעֵינֶ֛יךָ לָלֶ֖כֶת לֵ֑ךְ וַיִּתֶּן־ל֧וֹ רַב־טַבָּחִ֛ים אֲרֻחָ֥ה וּמַשְׂאֵ֖ת וַֽיְשַׁלְּחֵֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he still not would return, and return to Gedaliah son of Ahikam son of Shaphan, whom appointed [the] king of Babylon over [the] cities of Judah, and stay with him in [the] midst of the people, or to all the right in your eyes to go, go. And gave to him [the] chief of [the] guard an allowance and a gift, and he sent him away.

en.L: And [while] he [was] still not turning back, "So return to Gedaliah son of Ahikam son of Shaphan, whom the king of Babylon has appointed over the cities of Judah, and stay with him among the people; or go wherever [it is] right in your eyes to go." And the chief of the guard gave him an allowance of food and a gift, and let him go.
en.B: Before Jeremiah had turned to go, Nebuzaradan added, "Go back to Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, the man the king of Babylon has set over the towns of Judah, and live with him among the people. Or go anywhere else you think right." Then the captain of the guard gave him food for the journey and a gift, and let him go.
en.R: Before Jeremiah turned to leave, Nebuzaradan said, "Go back to Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan. The king of Babylon has put him in charge of the towns of Judah. Live with him among the people there. Or go anywhere else you choose." Then the commander of the guard gave Jeremiah food and a gift and let him go.

es.L: Y como él todavía no se volvía, [le dijo]: «Vuelve, pues, a Gedalías hijo de Ahicam, hijo de Safán, a quien el rey de Babilonia ha puesto sobre las ciudades de Judá, y quédate con él en medio del pueblo; o ve adonde [sea] recto a tus ojos ir». Y el jefe de la guardia le dio provisiones y un regalo, y lo despidió.
es.B: Antes de que Jeremías se diera la vuelta para irse, Nabuzaradán añadió: «Vuelve a Gedalías hijo de Ahicam, hijo de Safán, el hombre que el rey de Babilonia ha puesto sobre las ciudades de Judá, y vive con él entre el pueblo. O ve a cualquier otro lugar que te parezca bien». Entonces el capitán de la guardia le dio provisiones para el camino y un regalo, y lo dejó ir.
es.R: Antes de que Jeremías se fuera, Nabuzaradán le dijo: «Vuelve a Gedalías hijo de Ahicam, hijo de Safán. El rey de Babilonia lo ha puesto a cargo de las ciudades de Judá. Vive con él entre la gente de allí. O ve a cualquier otro lugar que quieras». Luego el comandante de la guardia le dio a Jeremías alimentos y un regalo, y lo dejó ir.

fr.L: Et comme il ne s’en retournait pas encore : « Retourne donc vers Guedalia fils d’Ahiqam, fils de Shaphân, que le roi de Babylone a établi sur les villes de Juda, et demeure avec lui au milieu du peuple ; ou bien va là où il [est] droit à tes yeux d’aller. » Et le chef des gardes lui donna des vivres et un présent, et le laissa partir.
fr.B: Avant que Jérémie se soit retourné pour partir, Nebouzaradân ajouta : « Retourne auprès de Guedalia fils d’Ahiqam, fils de Shaphân, que le roi de Babylone a établi sur les villes de Juda, et vis avec lui au milieu du peuple. Ou bien va partout ailleurs où il te semble juste d’aller. » Puis le commandant de la garde lui donna des provisions de route et un présent, et le laissa partir.
fr.R: Avant que Jérémie se retourne pour partir, Nebouzaradân lui a dit : « Retourne auprès de Guedalia fils d’Ahiqam, fils de Shaphân. Le roi de Babylone l’a mis à la tête des villes de Juda. Vis avec lui au milieu des gens qui sont là-bas. Ou bien va n’importe où ailleurs, comme tu le choisiras. » Puis le chef de la garde a donné à Jérémie de la nourriture et un cadeau, et il l’a laissé partir.

sw.L: Na [alipokuwa] bado hajageuka kurudi, "Basi rudi kwa Gedalia mwana wa Ahikamu mwana wa Shafani, ambaye mfalme wa Babeli amemweka juu ya miji ya Yuda, ukae naye katikati ya watu; au uende popote palipo haki machoni pako kwenda." Naye mkuu wa walinzi akampa posho la chakula na zawadi, akamwacha aende.
sw.B: Kabla Yeremia hajageuka kwenda, Nebuzaradani akaongeza, "Rudi kwa Gedalia mwana wa Ahikamu, mwana wa Shafani, ambaye mfalme wa Babeli amemweka juu ya miji ya Yuda, ukae naye kati ya watu. Au nenda mahali pengine popote unapoona ni haki." Kisha kamanda wa walinzi akampa chakula cha safari na zawadi, akamwacha aende.
sw.R: Kabla Yeremia hajageuka kuondoka, Nebuzaradani akasema, "Rudi kwa Gedalia mwana wa Ahikamu, mwana wa Shafani. Mfalme wa Babeli amemweka kuwa msimamizi wa miji ya Yuda. Kaa naye kati ya watu walioko huko. Au nenda mahali pengine popote unapotaka." Kisha kamanda wa walinzi akampa Yeremia chakula na zawadi, akamwacha aende.

vi.L: Trong khi ông chưa quay đi, [hắn nói]: "Hãy trở về với Ghê-đa-lia con trai A-hi-cam, con trai Sa-phan, là người vua Ba-by-lôn đã lập cai quản các thành Giu-đa, và ở với người ấy giữa dân chúng; hoặc ông thấy đâu là phải để đi, thì hãy đi." Quan chỉ huy vệ binh cấp cho ông lương thực và một món quà, rồi để ông đi.
vi.B: Trước khi Giê-rê-mi quay đi, Nê-bu-xa-a-đan nói thêm: "Hãy trở về với Ghê-đa-lia con trai A-hi-cam, cháu Sa-phan, là người vua Ba-by-lôn đã lập cai quản các thành Giu-đa, và hãy sống với người ấy giữa dân chúng. Hoặc ông thấy đi đâu là phải thì cứ đi." Rồi quan chỉ huy đội cận vệ cấp cho ông lương thực đi đường và một món quà, rồi để ông đi.
vi.R: Trước khi Giê-rê-mi quay đi, Nê-bu-xa-a-đan nói: "Hãy trở về với Ghê-đa-lia con trai A-hi-cam, cháu Sa-phan. Vua Ba-by-lôn đã giao cho người ấy cai quản các thành Giu-đa. Hãy sống với người ấy giữa dân chúng ở đó. Hoặc ông muốn đi đâu thì cứ đi." Rồi người chỉ huy đội cận vệ cho Giê-rê-mi lương thực và một món quà, rồi để ông đi.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 아직 돌아서지 않고 [있을 때, 그가 말했다]. "그러면 바빌론 왕이 유다 성읍들 위에 세운 사반의 손자 아히감의 아들 그다랴에게 돌아가서 백성 가운데서 그와 함께 머무르시오. 아니면 당신의 눈에 옳은 곳 어디로든 가시오." 그리고 경호대장이 그에게 양식과 선물을 주어 그를 보냈다.
ko.B: 예레미야가 아직 떠나지 않고 있을 때에 느부사라단이 덧붙여 말했다. "바빌론 왕이 유다 성읍들을 다스리도록 세운 사반의 손자요 아히감의 아들인 그다랴에게 돌아가서, 백성 가운데서 그와 함께 사시오. 아니면 당신이 옳다고 생각하는 곳 어디로든 가시오." 그러고 나서 경호대장은 그에게 길에서 먹을 양식과 선물을 주어 보냈다.
ko.R: 예레미야가 아직 떠나기 전에 느부사라단이 말했다. "사반의 손자요 아히감의 아들인 그다랴에게 돌아가시오. 바빌론 왕이 그에게 유다 성읍들을 맡겼소. 거기서 그와 함께 백성 가운데 사시오. 아니면 당신이 원하는 곳 어디로든 가시오." 그러고 나서 경호대장은 예레미야에게 먹을 것과 선물을 주어 보냈다.

pt.L: E [enquanto] ele ainda não se voltava, "Então volte para Gedalias, filho de Aicam, filho de Safã, a quem o rei da Babilônia pôs sobre as cidades de Judá, e fique com ele no meio do povo; ou vá para onde [for] reto aos seus olhos ir." E o chefe da guarda lhe deu uma provisão de comida e um presente, e o deixou ir.
pt.B: Antes que Jeremias se virasse para partir, Nebuzaradã acrescentou: "Volte para Gedalias, filho de Aicam, filho de Safã, o homem que o rei da Babilônia pôs sobre as cidades de Judá, e more com ele no meio do povo. Ou vá para qualquer outro lugar que achar certo." Então o capitão da guarda lhe deu comida para a viagem e um presente, e o deixou ir.
pt.R: Antes que Jeremias se virasse para ir embora, Nebuzaradã disse: "Volte para Gedalias, filho de Aicam, neto de Safã. O rei da Babilônia o pôs como responsável pelas cidades de Judá. More com ele ali, no meio do povo. Ou vá para qualquer outro lugar que você escolher." Então o comandante da guarda deu a Jeremias comida e um presente, e o deixou ir.

am.L: እርሱም ገና ሳይመለስ [እንዲህ አለው]፦ «እንግዲህ የባቢሎን ንጉሥ በይሁዳ ከተሞች ላይ ወደ ሾመው ወደ ሳፋን ልጅ ወደ አኪቃም ልጅ ወደ ጎዶልያስ ተመለስ፤ ከእርሱም ጋር በሕዝቡ መካከል ተቀመጥ፤ ወይም ትሄድ ዘንድ በዓይንህ ቅን ወደ ሆነው ስፍራ ሁሉ ሂድ።» የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ስንቅና ስጦታ ሰጥቶ አሰናበተው።
am.B: ኤርምያስ ለመሄድ ገና ሳይዞር ናቡዘረዳን እንዲህ ሲል ጨመረ፦ «የባቢሎን ንጉሥ በይሁዳ ከተሞች ላይ ወደ ሾመው ወደ ሳፋን ልጅ ወደ አኪቃም ልጅ ወደ ጎዶልያስ ተመለስ፤ ከእርሱም ጋር በሕዝቡ መካከል ኑር። ወይም ትክክል ነው ብለህ ወደምታስበው ወደ ሌላ ስፍራ ሂድ።» ከዚያም የዘበኞቹ አለቃ የመንገድ ስንቅና ስጦታ ሰጥቶ አሰናበተው።
am.R: ኤርምያስ ለመሄድ ገና ሳይዞር ናቡዘረዳን እንዲህ አለው፦ «ወደ ሳፋን የልጅ ልጅ ወደ አኪቃም ልጅ ወደ ጎዶልያስ ተመለስ። የባቢሎን ንጉሥ በይሁዳ ከተሞች ላይ ኃላፊ አድርጎ ሾሞታል። በዚያ ከእርሱ ጋር በሕዝቡ መካከል ኑር። ወይም ወደምትፈልገው ወደ ሌላ ስፍራ ሂድ።» ከዚያም የዘበኞቹ አዛዥ ለኤርምያስ ስንቅና ስጦታ ሰጥቶ አሰናበተው።

hi.L: और [जब] वह अभी लौटा भी न [था], "तो शापान के पुत्र अहीकाम के पुत्र गदल्याह के पास लौट जाओ, जिसे बाबुल के राजा ने यहूदा के नगरों पर ठहराया है, और लोगों के बीच उसके साथ रहो; या जहाँ जाना तुम्हारी आँखों में ठीक [लगे], वहाँ जाओ।" और अंगरक्षकों के प्रधान ने उसे भोजन-सामग्री और एक भेंट दी, और उसे विदा किया।
hi.B: यिर्मयाह अभी मुड़ा भी न था कि नबूज़रदान ने आगे कहा, "शापान के पोते, अहीकाम के पुत्र गदल्याह के पास लौट जाओ, जिसे बाबुल के राजा ने यहूदा के नगरों पर ठहराया है, और लोगों के बीच उसके साथ रहो। या जहाँ कहीं जाना तुम्हें ठीक लगे, वहाँ जाओ।" तब अंगरक्षकों के प्रधान ने उसे रास्ते के लिए भोजन और एक भेंट देकर विदा किया।
hi.R: यिर्मयाह के जाने से पहले ही नबूज़रदान ने कहा, "शापान के पोते, अहीकाम के पुत्र गदल्याह के पास लौट जाओ। बाबुल के राजा ने उसे यहूदा के नगरों का अधिकारी बनाया है। वहाँ लोगों के बीच उसके साथ रहो। या जहाँ तुम चाहो, वहाँ चले जाओ।" फिर अंगरक्षकों के सेनापति ने यिर्मयाह को भोजन और एक भेंट देकर विदा किया।

ru.L: И [пока] он ещё не повернул назад: «Так вернись к Годолии, сыну Ахикама, сына Шафана, которого царь Вавилона поставил над городами Иуды, и живи с ним среди народа; или иди, куда правильно в твоих глазах идти.» И дал ему начальник телохранителей продовольствие и подарок и отпустил его.
ru.B: Прежде чем Иеремия повернулся, чтобы уйти, Навузардан добавил: «Вернись к Годолии, сыну Ахикама, сына Шафана, которого царь Вавилона поставил над городами Иуды, и живи с ним среди народа. Или иди куда угодно, куда сочтёшь правильным.» Потом начальник стражи дал ему еды на дорогу и подарок и отпустил его.
ru.R: Прежде чем Иеремия повернулся, чтобы уйти, Навузардан сказал: «Вернись к Годолии, сыну Ахикама, сына Шафана. Царь Вавилона поставил его начальником над городами Иуды. Живи с ним там среди людей. Или иди куда хочешь.» Потом командир стражи дал Иеремии еды и подарок и отпустил его.

ja.L: そして彼がまだ戻らないうちに、「では、シャファンの子アヒカムの子ゲダルヤのもとへ帰れ。バビロンの王が彼をユダの町々の上に任命したのだ。彼と共に民の中に住め。あるいは、あなたの目に正しいと思われる所へ、どこへでも行け。」そして護衛隊長は彼に食糧と贈り物を与えて、彼を去らせた。
ja.B: エレミヤがまだ立ち去らないうちに、ネブザルアダンは言い添えた。「シャファンの子アヒカムの子ゲダルヤのもとへ帰りなさい。バビロンの王が、ユダの町々の上に立てた人だ。彼と共に民の中で暮らしなさい。あるいは、正しいと思うほかの所へ、どこへでも行きなさい。」そして護衛隊長は、彼に旅の食糧と贈り物を与えて、去らせた。
ja.R: エレミヤが立ち去ろうとする前に、ネブザルアダンは言いました。「シャファンの孫で、アヒカムの息子であるゲダルヤのところへ帰りなさい。バビロンの王は、ユダの町々を治める責任者として彼を立てた。彼と一緒に、そこの人々の中で暮らしなさい。あるいは、ほかに行きたい所があれば、どこへでも行きなさい。」それから護衛隊長は、エレミヤに食べ物と贈り物を与えて、送り出しました。

decisions.choice: And while he had not yet turned back: before Jeremiah could answer or leave, the captain went on
alternatives: Jeremiah still hesitated to go back, so the captain urged him
a damaged text, read differently by the Greek translation
decisions.reason: The Hebrew of this clause is obscure. Word for word it says "and he still would not return", followed at once by "and return to Gedaliah". It is read here as a remark that Jeremiah had not yet turned to go, or had not yet answered, when the captain added his advice. Others take it to mean that Jeremiah hesitated, so the captain urged him. The Greek translation seems to have read a different text here, something like "but if not, run back". The Hebrew is followed, and the reading is uncertain. The account of the Greek is from general knowledge.

decisions.choice: Gedaliah: the governor appointed over Judah
decisions.reason: On Gedaliah and his family see 2 Kings 25:22. His father Ahikam had protected Jeremiah years before (26:24). The captain points Jeremiah to the man now in charge of the land.

decisions.choice: an allowance: a ration of food
decisions.reason: The word names a set portion of food, like the daily allowance given to King Jehoiachin in Babylon (52:34; 2 Kings 25:30). With the gift, it shows the care the captain had promised in verse 4.

decisions.choice: Nebuzaradan added (Balanced); Nebuzaradan said (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew goes straight into the captain's words without saying who speaks. Balanced and Readable name him, since the clause before is about Jeremiah. Literal keeps the bare Hebrew.

decisions.choice: food for the journey (Balanced); food (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced shows the purpose of the allowance (m3); Readable keeps it simple.

decisions.choice: [le dijo]
decisions.reason: The Hebrew begins this verse without a word of speaking; Literal supplies one in brackets, where the English Literal opens the quotation without it.

decisions.choice: [hắn nói] (L)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew runs straight from the narrative into the commander's words; Literal supplies the verb of speaking in brackets so the Vietnamese can be read.

decisions.choice: "그가 아직 돌아서지 않고 [있을 때, 그가 말했다]" (L)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is abrupt here (meaning decision); Korean Literal brackets the words it needs to introduce the captain's speech, as Balanced and Readable say them.

decisions.choice: E [enquanto] ele ainda não se voltava, "Então volte ..." (L)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew of the clause is obscure (m1); Literal keeps its bare form, as the English Literal does, and Balanced and Readable say who speaks.

decisions.choice: "[እንዲህ አለው]" supplied at Literal before the officer's words.
alternatives: a quotation with no verb of saying
decisions.reason: The Hebrew goes straight into the speech; Amharic needs a verb of saying to open a quotation inside a sentence. The allowance is "ስንቅ" (provisions), as the meaning decision's ration of food.

decisions.choice: शापान के पोते, अहीकाम के पुत्र गदल्याह
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "grandson of Shaphan", as 2 Kings 25:22 does in Hindi for the same man; Literal keeps the chain of "son of".

decisions.choice: भोजन-सामग्री (L); रास्ते के लिए भोजन (B); भोजन (R)
decisions.reason: The allowance is a ration of food, as the English levels say.

decisions.choice: "[пока] он ещё не повернул назад" (L); "Прежде чем Иеремия повернулся, чтобы уйти" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is hard (m1); Literal keeps its words, and Balanced and Readable name Jeremiah and Nebuzaradan, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Gedaliah son of Ahikam son of Shaphan "シャファンの子アヒカムの子ゲダルヤ" (L, B), "シャファンの孫で、アヒカムの息子であるゲダルヤ" (R); hifqid "任命した" (L), "立てた" (B), "責任者として…立てた" (R), as 2KI 25:22.
decisions.reason: Keep the 2 Kings 25:22 names and wording (m2).

decisions.choice: L leaves the speaker unnamed before the quotation, as the Hebrew does: "彼がまだ戻らないうちに、「…」".
alternatives: ネブザルアダンは言った
decisions.reason: m1: the Hebrew is abrupt and the text uncertain; L keeps the abruptness, B and R name the speaker as the English.

en.L: And Jeremiah went to Gedaliah son of Ahikam at Mizpah, and stayed with him among the people who were left in the land.

es.B: Así que Jeremías fue a Mizpa, a ver a Gedalías hijo de Ahicam, y vivió allí con él entre el pueblo que había quedado en la tierra.

sw.R: Basi Yeremia akaenda kwa Gedalia mwana wa Ahikamu huko Mizpa. Akakaa huko pamoja naye kati ya watu waliokuwa wameachwa katika nchi.

ru.L: И пришёл Иеремия к Годолии, сыну Ахикама, в Мицпу, и остался с ним среди народа, оставшегося в земле.

ja.L: そしてエレミヤはミツパへ、アヒカムの子ゲダルヤのもとへ行き、その地に残された民の中で、彼と共に住んだ。
ja.B: そこでエレミヤはミツパへ行き、アヒカムの子ゲダルヤのもとに身を寄せ、その地に残された民の中で彼と共に暮らした。
ja.R: そこでエレミヤは、ミツパにいるアヒカムの息子ゲダルヤのところへ行きました。そして、その地に残された人々の中で、ゲダルヤと一緒に暮らしました。

decisions.choice: Mizpah: a town of Benjamin north of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 25:23. With Jerusalem in ruins, Gedaliah governed from Mizpah, a few miles to the north.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah chooses to stay in the land
decisions.reason: He could have gone to Babylon under the captain's protection. He stayed with the poor who were left. His choice fits his message that life would go on in the land: "houses and fields and vineyards will again be bought in this land" (32:15).

decisions.choice: Mispá
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the town (m1) is "Mispá", as 2 Kings 25:23 and the shared rules for Jeremiah set it, through chapters 40-41.

decisions.choice: "Мицпа"
decisions.reason: The town of Benjamin (m1), in the form of 2 Kings 25:23 and 1 Samuel 7 in this translation, kept through chapter 41.

decisions.choice: Mizpah "ミツパ" at every level (2KI 25:23, 1KI).
decisions.reason: m1; the settled form.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ֩ כָל־שָׂרֵ֨י הַחֲיָלִ֜ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּשָּׂדֶ֗ה הֵ֚מָּה וְאַנְשֵׁיהֶ֔ם כִּֽי־הִפְקִ֧יד מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֛ל אֶת־גְּדַלְיָ֥הוּ בֶן־אֲחִיקָ֖ם בָּאָ֑רֶץ וְכִ֣י׀הִפְקִ֣יד אִתּ֗וֹ אֲנָשִׁ֤ים וְנָשִׁים֙ וָטָ֔ף וּמִדַּלַּ֣ת הָאָ֔רֶץ מֵאֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־הָגְל֖וּ בָּבֶֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And heard all [the] commanders of the forces who [were] in the field, they and their men, that had appointed [the] king of Babylon Gedaliah son of Ahikam over the land, and that he had entrusted to him men and women and little ones, and from [the] poor of the land, from those who had not been exiled to Babylon,

en.L: And all the commanders of the forces who [were] in the open country, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam over the land, and that he had entrusted to him men and women and little ones, and some of the poorest of the land, of those who had not been taken into exile to Babylon,
en.B: All the commanders of the forces who were in the open country and their men learned that the king of Babylon had set Gedaliah son of Ahikam over the land and had placed in his care men, women and children, those of the poorest people of the land who had not been taken into exile to Babylon,
en.R: All the army commanders and their men who were still out in the open country heard that the king of Babylon had put Gedaliah son of Ahikam in charge of the land. They heard that he had also put Gedaliah in charge of the men, women and children who had not been taken away to Babylon, the poorest people in the land.

es.L: Y oyeron todos los jefes de las tropas que [estaban] en el campo, ellos y sus hombres, que el rey de Babilonia había puesto a Gedalías hijo de Ahicam sobre la tierra, y que le había encomendado hombres, mujeres y niños, y de los pobres de la tierra, de los que no habían sido llevados cautivos a Babilonia,
es.B: Todos los jefes de las tropas que estaban en el campo, y sus hombres, se enteraron de que el rey de Babilonia había nombrado a Gedalías hijo de Ahicam sobre la tierra y había puesto a su cargo a hombres, mujeres y niños, los más pobres del país que no habían sido llevados al destierro en Babilonia,
es.R: Todos los jefes del ejército y sus hombres, que todavía estaban en el campo, oyeron que el rey de Babilonia había puesto a Gedalías hijo de Ahicam a cargo del país. Oyeron que también lo había puesto a cargo de los hombres, las mujeres y los niños que no habían sido llevados a Babilonia, la gente más pobre del país.

fr.L: Et tous les chefs des troupes qui [étaient] dans la campagne, eux et leurs hommes, apprirent que le roi de Babylone avait établi Guedalia fils d’Ahiqam sur le pays, et qu’il lui avait confié des hommes, des femmes et des enfants, et des plus pauvres du pays, de ceux qui n’avaient pas été déportés à Babylone,
fr.B: Tous les chefs des troupes qui étaient dans la campagne, ainsi que leurs hommes, apprirent que le roi de Babylone avait établi Guedalia fils d’Ahiqam sur le pays et lui avait confié des hommes, des femmes et des enfants, ceux des plus pauvres du pays qui n’avaient pas été emmenés en exil à Babylone,
fr.R: Tous les chefs de l’armée et leurs hommes qui étaient encore dans la campagne ont appris que le roi de Babylone avait mis Guedalia fils d’Ahiqam à la tête du pays. Ils ont appris qu’il lui avait aussi confié les hommes, les femmes et les enfants qui n’avaient pas été emmenés à Babylone, les plus pauvres du pays.

sw.L: Nao wakuu wote wa majeshi waliokuwa nyikani, wao na watu wao, waliposikia kwamba mfalme wa Babeli amemweka Gedalia mwana wa Ahikamu juu ya nchi, na kwamba amemkabidhi wanaume na wanawake na watoto, na baadhi ya maskini wa nchi, wale ambao hawakuhamishwa kwenda Babeli,
sw.B: Wakuu wote wa majeshi waliokuwa nyikani pamoja na watu wao walisikia kwamba mfalme wa Babeli amemweka Gedalia mwana wa Ahikamu juu ya nchi, na kwamba amemkabidhi wanaume, wanawake na watoto, wale wa watu maskini kabisa wa nchi ambao hawakuchukuliwa uhamishoni Babeli,
sw.R: Makamanda wote wa jeshi na watu wao waliokuwa bado nyikani walisikia kwamba mfalme wa Babeli amemweka Gedalia mwana wa Ahikamu kuwa msimamizi wa nchi. Walisikia kwamba amemweka Gedalia pia kuwa msimamizi wa wanaume, wanawake na watoto ambao hawakupelekwa Babeli, watu maskini kabisa wa nchi.

vi.L: Tất cả các tướng chỉ huy quân lính ở ngoài đồng, họ và người của họ, nghe rằng vua Ba-by-lôn đã lập Ghê-đa-lia con trai A-hi-cam cai quản xứ, và đã giao cho người ấy đàn ông, đàn bà và trẻ nhỏ, cùng một số người nghèo nhất trong xứ, là những người chưa bị đem đi lưu đày sang Ba-by-lôn,
vi.B: Tất cả các tướng chỉ huy quân lính đang ở ngoài đồng cùng người của họ nghe tin vua Ba-by-lôn đã lập Ghê-đa-lia con trai A-hi-cam cai quản xứ, và đã giao cho người ấy coi sóc đàn ông, đàn bà và trẻ con, tức là những người nghèo nhất trong xứ chưa bị đem đi lưu đày sang Ba-by-lôn,
vi.R: Tất cả các tướng chỉ huy quân đội và người của họ còn đang ở ngoài đồng nghe tin vua Ba-by-lôn đã giao cho Ghê-đa-lia con trai A-hi-cam cai quản xứ. Họ cũng nghe rằng vua đã giao cho Ghê-đa-lia coi sóc những đàn ông, đàn bà và trẻ con chưa bị đem đi Ba-by-lôn, là những người nghèo nhất trong xứ.

ko.L: 그리고 들에 있던 군대 지휘관들, 곧 그들과 그 부하들이, 바빌론 왕이 아히감의 아들 그다랴를 그 땅 위에 세우고, 남자들과 여자들과 어린아이들과 바빌론으로 사로잡혀 가지 않은 그 땅의 가난한 자들 가운데 일부를 그에게 맡겼다는 소식을 듣고,
ko.B: 들판에 있던 모든 군대 지휘관과 그들의 부하들은, 바빌론 왕이 아히감의 아들 그다랴를 그 땅의 총독으로 세우고, 바빌론으로 사로잡혀 가지 않은 그 땅의 가장 가난한 사람들, 곧 남자와 여자와 아이들을 그에게 맡겼다는 소식을 들었다.
ko.R: 아직 들판에 있던 모든 군대 지휘관과 그들의 부하들은, 바빌론 왕이 아히감의 아들 그다랴에게 그 땅을 맡겼다는 소식을 들었다. 그들은 또 바빌론으로 끌려가지 않은 남자와 여자와 아이들, 곧 그 땅의 가장 가난한 사람들도 그다랴에게 맡겼다는 소식을 들었다.

pt.L: E todos os chefes das tropas que [estavam] no campo, eles e os seus homens, ouviram que o rei da Babilônia tinha posto Gedalias, filho de Aicam, sobre a terra, e que lhe tinha confiado homens, e mulheres, e crianças, e alguns dos pobres da terra, dos que não tinham sido levados para o exílio na Babilônia,
pt.B: Todos os comandantes das tropas que estavam no campo e os seus homens ficaram sabendo que o rei da Babilônia tinha posto Gedalias, filho de Aicam, sobre a terra e lhe tinha confiado homens, mulheres e crianças, os mais pobres da terra, que não tinham sido levados para o exílio na Babilônia,
pt.R: Todos os comandantes do exército e os seus homens que ainda estavam no campo ouviram que o rei da Babilônia tinha posto Gedalias, filho de Aicam, como responsável pela terra. Ouviram também que ele tinha posto Gedalias como responsável pelos homens, mulheres e crianças que não tinham sido levados para a Babilônia, as pessoas mais pobres da terra.

am.L: በሜዳ የነበሩትም የጭፍሮቹ አለቆች ሁሉ፣ እነርሱና ሰዎቻቸው፣ የባቢሎን ንጉሥ የአኪቃምን ልጅ ጎዶልያስን በምድሪቱ ላይ እንደ ሾመው፣ ወንዶችንና ሴቶችን ሕፃናትንም፣ ወደ ባቢሎንም ካልፈለሱት ከምድሪቱ ድሆች [አንዳንዶቹን] አደራ እንደ ሰጠው ሰሙ፤
am.B: በገጠር የነበሩት የጭፍሮቹ አለቆች ሁሉና ሰዎቻቸው የባቢሎን ንጉሥ የአኪቃምን ልጅ ጎዶልያስን በምድሪቱ ላይ እንደ ሾመውና ወደ ባቢሎን ያልተማረኩትን የምድሪቱን ድሆች፣ ወንዶችን፣ ሴቶችንና ልጆችን በእርሱ እጅ አደራ እንደ ሰጠ በሰሙ ጊዜ፣
am.R: ገና በገጠር የነበሩት የጦር አዛዦች ሁሉና ሰዎቻቸው የባቢሎን ንጉሥ የአኪቃምን ልጅ ጎዶልያስን በምድሪቱ ላይ ኃላፊ አድርጎ እንደ ሾመው ሰሙ። ወደ ባቢሎን ያልተወሰዱትን ወንዶች፣ ሴቶችና ልጆች፣ ማለትም የምድሪቱን በጣም ድሆች፣ በጎዶልያስ ኃላፊነት ሥር እንዳደረጋቸው ደግሞ ሰሙ።

hi.L: और सेनाओं के सब प्रधानों ने, जो मैदान में [थे], उन्होंने और उनके आदमियों ने सुना कि बाबुल के राजा ने अहीकाम के पुत्र गदल्याह को देश पर ठहराया है, और उसे पुरुष और स्त्रियाँ और बाल-बच्चे, और देश के कंगालों में से [कुछ], उनमें से जो बाबुल को निर्वासित नहीं किए गए थे, सौंपे हैं,
hi.B: जब सेनाओं के सब प्रधानों और उनके आदमियों ने, जो मैदान में थे, सुना कि बाबुल के राजा ने अहीकाम के पुत्र गदल्याह को देश पर ठहराया है, और पुरुष, स्त्रियाँ और बच्चे, अर्थात देश के वे सबसे कंगाल लोग जो निर्वासन में बाबुल नहीं ले जाए गए थे, उसकी देखरेख में सौंपे हैं,
hi.R: सेना के सब प्रधानों और उनके आदमियों ने, जो अब तक खुले देहात में थे, सुना कि बाबुल के राजा ने अहीकाम के पुत्र गदल्याह को देश का अधिकारी बनाया है। उन्होंने यह भी सुना कि उसने गदल्याह को उन पुरुषों, स्त्रियों और बच्चों का अधिकारी बनाया है जो बाबुल नहीं ले जाए गए थे, यानी देश के सबसे कंगाल लोगों का।

ru.L: И услышали все начальники войск, которые [были] в поле, они и их люди, что царь Вавилона поставил Годолию, сына Ахикама, над землёй и что он поручил ему мужчин, и женщин, и детей, и [некоторых] из бедноты земли, из тех, кого не переселили в Вавилон,
ru.B: Все начальники войск, которые были в поле, и их люди узнали, что царь Вавилона поставил Годолию, сына Ахикама, над страной и поручил ему мужчин, женщин и детей — тех из самых бедных людей страны, кого не увели в изгнание в Вавилон,
ru.R: Все военачальники и их воины, которые ещё оставались в поле, услышали, что царь Вавилона поставил Годолию, сына Ахикама, начальником над страной. Они услышали, что он поручил Годолии мужчин, женщин и детей, которых не угнали в плен в Вавилон, — самых бедных людей страны.

ja.L: さて、野にいたすべての軍の長たち、彼らとその兵たちは、バビロンの王がアヒカムの子ゲダルヤをその地の上に任命したこと、また、男と女と幼い子どもたち、およびバビロンへ捕らえ移されなかったその地の最も貧しい者たちの一部を、彼に託したことを聞いた。
ja.B: 野にいたすべての軍の司令官たちとその部下たちは、バビロンの王がアヒカムの子ゲダルヤをその地の上に立て、男や女や子どもたち、すなわち、バビロンへ捕囚として連れ去られなかったその地の最も貧しい民を、彼に託したことを聞いた。
ja.R: まだ野に残っていたすべての軍の司令官とその部下たちは、バビロンの王が、アヒカムの息子ゲダルヤをその地の責任者にしたと聞きました。また、バビロンへ連れて行かれなかった男や女や子どもたち、つまり、その地の最も貧しい人々の世話も、王がゲダルヤに任せたと聞きました。

decisions.choice: the account of 2 Kings 25:23-24, told more fully
decisions.reason: Verses 7-9 tell what 2 Kings 25:23-24 tells, often in the same words. Jeremiah adds that the commanders were "in the open country", that Gedaliah was set "over the land", and that the people left behind were put in his care. Verses 10-16 have no parallel in Kings.

decisions.choice: the commanders of the forces in the open country: Judah's officers still at large
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 25:23. When the city fell, the army scattered (39:4-5; 52:7-8), and some officers stayed out in the countryside with their men.

decisions.choice: and some of the poorest: the men, women and children left were the poor of the land
decisions.reason: The "and" introduces who these people were rather than a second group. The Babylonians had taken the leading families into exile and left the poorest people to work the land (39:10; 52:16; 2 Kings 25:12).

decisions.choice: wording of 2 Kings 25:23 reused; the sentence runs on into verse 8
decisions.reason: Where the Hebrew is the same as 2 Kings 25:23, Literal and Readable keep the wording used there, and Balanced stays close to it ("set ... over the land" for "appointed"). The sentence continues into verse 8, so Literal and Balanced end with a comma; Readable makes two sentences of it.

decisions.choice: wording of 2 Kings 25:23 reused (los jefes de las tropas, Mizpa, the list of names)
decisions.reason: Verses 7-9 tell what 2 Kings 25:23-24 tells, more fully; the published Spanish is reused where the Hebrew is the same. The sentence runs on into verse 8.

decisions.choice: "wakuu wa majeshi" (L, B), "makamanda wa jeshi" (R), as 2 Kings 25:23
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 40:7-9 tells again 2 Kings 25:23-24; the Swahili wording of that passage is kept where the Hebrew is the same.

decisions.choice: "les chefs des troupes" (L, B), "les chefs de l’armée" (R), and the names and wording of 2 Kings 25:23-24
decisions.reason: Verses 7-9 retell 2 Kings 25:23-24 more fully; the French reuses the published wording of Kings at each level where the Hebrew is the same.

decisions.choice: các tướng chỉ huy quân lính
decisions.reason: Verses 7-9 tell again what 2 Kings 25:23-24 tells; the Vietnamese reuses the published wording there, "các tướng chỉ huy quân lính", and its names.

decisions.choice: "군대 지휘관들" and "그들과 그 부하들", as published in 2 Kings 25:23; "그 땅의 총독으로" (B)
decisions.reason: The terms note's rule for parallels: the shared words keep the Korean of 2 Kings 25:23-24 at each level.

decisions.choice: Balanced ends verse 7 with "들었다." and verse 8 begins "그래서 그들은"
decisions.reason: So that each verse keeps its own content after its marker.

decisions.choice: os chefes das tropas (L), os comandantes das tropas (B), os comandantes do exército (R); tinha posto ... sobre
decisions.reason: Verses 7-9 tell what 2 Kings 25:23-24 tells (m1), and keep that passage's Portuguese at each level where the Hebrew is the same. For the whole book (41:11, 13, 16; 42:1, 8; 43:4-5), the commanders keep these words, those 2 Kings 25:23 gives them in Portuguese.

decisions.choice: "the commanders of the forces" keep 2 Kings 25:23's "የጭፍሮቹ አለቆች" (Literal, Balanced) and "የጦር አዛዦች" (Readable); "in the field" is "በሜዳ" (Literal), "በገጠር" (Balanced, Readable).
decisions.reason: Verses 7-9 tell 2 Kings 25:23-24 more fully; the Amharic keeps the Kings wording where the Hebrew is the same and follows this Hebrew for what it adds (the land, the people entrusted to Gedaliah).

decisions.choice: wording of 2 Kings 25:23 reused
decisions.reason: Verses 7-9 tell more fully what 2 Kings 25:23-24 tells; the Hindi keeps its wording at each level (सेनाओं के सब प्रधानों ने और उनके आदमियों ने सुना कि बाबुल के राजा ने गदल्याह को ठहराया है) and adds what the Hebrew adds here. Literal and Balanced keep the sentence running into verse 8.

records.literal_gloss: and they came to Gedaliah [to] Mizpah: and Ishmael son of Nethaniah, and Johanan and Jonathan sons of Kareah, and Seraiah son of Tanhumeth, and [the] sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah son of the Maacathite, they and their men.

en.L: and they came to Gedaliah at Mizpah: Ishmael son of Nethaniah, and Johanan and Jonathan sons of Kareah, and Seraiah son of Tanhumeth, and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah son of the Maacathite, they and their men.
en.B: and they came to Gedaliah at Mizpah. They were Ishmael son of Nethaniah, Johanan and Jonathan sons of Kareah, Seraiah son of Tanhumeth, the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah son of the Maacathite, together with their men.
en.R: So they came to Gedaliah at Mizpah. They were Ishmael son of Nethaniah, Johanan and Jonathan sons of Kareah, Seraiah son of Tanhumeth, the sons of Ephai from the town of Netophah, and Jezaniah son of the Maacathite. Their men came with them.

es.L: y vinieron a Gedalías [a] Mizpa: Ismael hijo de Netanías, y Johanán y Jonatán hijos de Carea, y Seraías hijo de Tanhumet, y los hijos de Efai el netofatita, y Jezanías hijo del maacateo, ellos y sus hombres.
es.B: y fueron a ver a Gedalías en Mizpa. Eran Ismael hijo de Netanías, Johanán y Jonatán hijos de Carea, Seraías hijo de Tanhumet, los hijos de Efai el netofatita y Jezanías hijo del maacateo, junto con sus hombres.
es.R: Así que fueron a ver a Gedalías en Mizpa. Eran Ismael hijo de Netanías, Johanán y Jonatán hijos de Carea, Seraías hijo de Tanhumet, los hijos de Efai, de la ciudad de Netofa, y Jezanías hijo del maacateo. Sus hombres fueron con ellos.

fr.L: et ils vinrent auprès de Guedalia, à Mitspa : Ismaël fils de Netania, et Yohanân et Jonathan fils de Qaréah, et Seraya fils de Tanhoumeth, et les fils d’Éphaï le Netophatite, et Yezania fils du Maakatite, eux et leurs hommes.

fr.R: Alors ils sont venus voir Guedalia à Mitspa. C’étaient Ismaël fils de Netania, Yohanân et Jonathan fils de Qaréah, Seraya fils de Tanhoumeth, les fils d’Éphaï, de la ville de Netopha, et Yezania fils du Maakatite. Leurs hommes sont venus avec eux.

ko.R: 그래서 그들은 미스바로 그다랴를 찾아왔다. 그들은 느다냐의 아들 이스마엘, 가레아의 아들들 요하난과 요나단, 단후멧의 아들 스라야, 느도바 성읍 출신 에배의 아들들, 마아가 사람의 아들 여사냐였다. 그들의 부하들도 함께 왔다.

am.R: ስለዚህ ወደ ጎዶልያስ ወደ ምጽጳ መጡ። እነርሱም የናታንያ ልጅ እስማኤል፣ የቃሬያ ልጆች ዮሐናንና ዮናታን፣ የተንሑሜት ልጅ ሠራያ፣ ከነጦፋ ከተማ የመጡት የዔፋይ ልጆችና የመዓካታዊው ልጅ ይዛንያ ነበሩ። ሰዎቻቸውም ከእነርሱ ጋር መጡ።

ja.L: そして彼らはミツパのゲダルヤのもとに来た。ネタンヤの子イシュマエル、カレアの子ヨハナンとヨナタン、タンフメトの子セラヤ、ネトファ人エファイの子ら、マアカ人の子ヤアザンヤ、彼らと彼らの兵たちである。
ja.B: そして彼らは、ミツパのゲダルヤのもとに来た。それは、ネタンヤの子イシュマエル、カレアの子ヨハナンとヨナタン、タンフメトの子セラヤ、ネトファ人エファイの子ら、マアカ人の子ヤアザンヤと、その部下たちであった。
ja.R: そこで彼らは、ミツパにいるゲダルヤのところへ来ました。それは、ネタンヤの息子イシュマエル、カレアの息子ヨハナンとヨナタン、タンフメトの息子セラヤ、ネトファの町のエファイの息子たち、マアカ人の息子ヤアザンヤでした。部下たちも一緒に来ました。

decisions.choice: a fuller list than 2 Kings 25:23
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 25:23 names Ishmael, Johanan, Seraiah and Jaazaniah. Jeremiah adds Jonathan, Johanan's brother, and the sons of Ephai. In Kings "the Netophathite" belongs to Seraiah; here it belongs to the sons of Ephai. Jezaniah is another spelling of the name Jaazaniah.

decisions.choice: Ephai, as the margin reads
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew text has a name that would be read Ophai; the scribes' marginal reading is Ephai, which is followed. Either way it is the same man.

decisions.choice: the Netophathite; the Maacathite
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 25:23: Netophah was a town near Bethlehem, and the Maacathites were a clan named for Maacah, a small Aramean region northeast of Galilee.

decisions.choice: Ishmael and Johanan: the two men the next chapters follow
decisions.reason: Ishmael will murder Gedaliah (41:1-3), and Johanan will lead the survivors who go down to Egypt (41:11-43:7).

decisions.choice: from the town of Netophah (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 25:23.

decisions.choice: Jezanías
decisions.reason: The Hebrew here has the form Jezaniah; 2 Kings 25:23 has Jaazaniah for the same man. Each keeps its own form.

decisions.choice: "Yohana mwana wa Karea", as 2 Kings 25:23
decisions.reason: The published Swahili form; this Johanan is an army officer of Judah, not John the Baptist or the apostle, who share the Swahili name. "Yezania" keeps this verse's spelling, where 2 Kings 25:23 has "Yaazania".

decisions.choice: "Yezania" here
decisions.reason: The Hebrew spells the name differently from 2 Kings 25:23 ("Yaazania"); each book keeps its own form, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Giê-xa-nia con trai người Ma-a-ca
decisions.reason: The Hebrew here has the form Jezaniah, where 2 Kings 25:23 has Jaazaniah; Vietnamese keeps the difference, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "여사냐" for Jezaniah here; "느도바 사람", "마아가 사람" as 2 Kings 25:23
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 25:23 has the form Jaazaniah (야아사냐); Jeremiah's Hebrew has Jezaniah, and each verse keeps its own form.

decisions.choice: Ismael, filho de Netanias; Joanã e Jônatas, filhos de Careá; Seraías, filho de Tanumete; Efai, o netofatita; Jezanias, filho do maacatita
decisions.reason: The names keep the forms 2 Kings 25:23 gives them in Portuguese (m1, m3), with "Netofa" at Readable as there. "Jezanias" follows this verse's Hebrew spelling, where Kings has "Jazanias", as the English keeps "Jezaniah" and "Jaazaniah" apart. "Efai" is the margin's reading (m2).

decisions.choice: 2 Kings 25:23's list copied, with Jonathan ("ዮናታን") and "the sons of Ephai the Netophathite" ("የነጦፋዊው የዔፋይ ልጆች") added and Jezaniah written "ይዛንያ" for Kings' "ያእዛንያ".
decisions.reason: The Hebrew here has the fuller list and spells the name Yezanyahu; the English writes Jezaniah, so the Amharic follows this spelling and the reader sees a different form in Kings.

decisions.choice: इश्माएल, नतन्याह, योहानान, कारेह, सरायाह, तन्हूमेत, नतोपाई, माकाई as 2 Kings 25:23; एपै; यज़न्याह
decisions.reason: The names keep the forms of 2 Kings 25:23 in Hindi. Ephai is new here (एपै). The Hebrew spells the last man Jezaniah here and Jaazaniah in 2 Kings 25:23; the Hindi keeps the two spellings apart (यज़न्याह, याज़न्याह) as the Hebrew does, though it is the same man.

decisions.choice: the names of 2 Kings 25:23 in this translation; "Ионафан"; "Ефай"
decisions.reason: The list of 2 Kings 25:23 keeps its forms (Измаил, Нафания, Иоанан, Карей, Сераия, Танхумеф, нетофафянин, Иезания, маахатянин). Jonathan takes the usual Russian form, and Ephai is spelled as the margin reads (m2).

decisions.choice: The 2 Kings 25:23 forms: "ネタンヤの子イシュマエル", "カレアの子ヨハナン", "タンフメトの子セラヤ", "ネトファ人", "マアカ人の子"; new: Jonathan "ヨナタン", Ephai "エファイ", Jezaniah "ヤアザンヤ", the 2 Kings 25:23 form for the same man.
decisions.reason: m1, m2: Yezanyahu is another spelling of the name Ya'azanyahu (m1); one Japanese form per person, as ユカル for Jehucal / Jucal (37:3, 38:1) and ネブカドネツァル for both spellings.

records.literal_gloss: And swore to them Gedaliah son of Ahikam son of Shaphan and to their men, saying, Do not fear to serve the Chaldeans; dwell in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will go well for you.

en.L: And Gedaliah son of Ahikam son of Shaphan swore to them and to their men, saying, "Do not be afraid to serve the Chaldeans. Dwell in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will be well with you.
en.B: Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, gave them and their men his sworn word. "Do not be afraid to serve the Chaldeans," he said. "Settle in the land, serve the king of Babylon, and all will go well with you.
en.R: Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, gave them and their men his promise, and he swore an oath to keep it. "Do not be afraid to serve the Babylonians," he said. "Stay in the land and serve the king of Babylon. Then things will go well for you.

es.L: Y Gedalías hijo de Ahicam, hijo de Safán, les juró a ellos y a sus hombres, diciendo: «No {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} miedo de servir a los caldeos; {{plural_you:habiten|habitad}} en la tierra y {{plural_you:sirvan|servid}} al rey de Babilonia, y {{plural_you:les|os}} irá bien.
es.B: Gedalías hijo de Ahicam, hijo de Safán, les dio su palabra con juramento a ellos y a sus hombres. «No {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} miedo de servir a los caldeos», les dijo. «{{plural_you:Quédense|Quedaos}} a vivir en la tierra, {{plural_you:sirvan|servid}} al rey de Babilonia, y todo {{plural_you:les|os}} irá bien.
es.R: Gedalías hijo de Ahicam, hijo de Safán, les hizo una promesa a ellos y a sus hombres, y juró que la cumpliría. «No {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} miedo de servir a los babilonios», les dijo. «{{plural_you:Quédense|Quedaos}} en el país y {{plural_you:sirvan|servid}} al rey de Babilonia. fr.L: Et Guedalia fils d’Ahiqam, fils de Shaphân, leur fit un serment, à eux et à leurs hommes, disant : « N’ayez pas peur de servir les Chaldéens. Habitez dans le pays et servez le roi de Babylone, et vous vous en trouverez bien.

am.L: የሳፋን ልጅ የአኪቃም ልጅ ጎዶልያስም ለእነርሱና ለሰዎቻቸው እንዲህ ብሎ ማለላቸው፦ «ከለዳውያንን ለማገልገል አትፍሩ፤ በምድሪቱ ተቀመጡ፤ ለባቢሎንም ንጉሥ ተገዙ፤ መልካምም ይሆንላችኋል።

am.R: የሳፋን የልጅ ልጅ የአኪቃም ልጅ ጎዶልያስ ለእነርሱና ለሰዎቻቸው ቃል ገባላቸው፤ ቃሉንም እንደሚጠብቅ ማለላቸው። «ባቢሎናውያንን ለማገልገል አትፍሩ» አላቸው። «በምድሪቱ ኑሩ፤ ለባቢሎንም ንጉሥ ተገዙ። እንዲህ ብታደርጉ መልካም ይሆንላችኋል።

ja.L: そして、シャファンの子アヒカムの子ゲダルヤは、彼らと彼らの兵たちに誓って言った。「カルデア人に仕えることを恐れてはならない。この地に住み、バビロンの王に仕えよ。そうすれば、あなたがたは幸いを得る。

decisions.choice: "to serve the Chaldeans", where 2 Kings 25:24 has "of the servants of the Chaldeans"
decisions.reason: The two Hebrew phrases differ by little more than a letter. In Kings the commanders are told not to fear the Babylonian officials; here they are told not to fear serving Babylon. Jeremiah also names Gedaliah's father and grandfather and adds "saying". The rest of the oath is word for word the same as Kings.

decisions.choice: swore to them: gave his word under oath
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 25:24. Gedaliah guaranteed with an oath that the commanders and their men would be safe if they accepted Babylonian rule.

decisions.choice: the counsel Jeremiah had given
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 25:24. Gedaliah repeats Jeremiah's message: serve the king of Babylon and live (27:11-12; 38:17), settle where you are and seek its good (29:4-7).

decisions.choice: Chaldeans (Literal, Balanced); Babylonians (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording of 2 Kings 25:24 is reused at Literal and Readable where the Hebrew is the same; Balanced says "gave them ... his sworn word" for "swore an oath to them", with the same sense. Readable says "Babylonians" for "Chaldeans", as everywhere in Jeremiah. The speech goes on in verse 10, so the quotation stays open.

decisions.choice: các ông (Gedaliah to the commanders); tôi
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 25:24, the governor speaks to the commanders as "các ông" and of himself as "tôi".

decisions.choice: Gedaliah speaks to the commanders in 하오체 with "여러분", as published in 2 Kings 25:24; they answer the governor in 합쇼체 (verses 14-15)
decisions.reason: The Kings decision carried over; only "to serve the Chaldeans" changes with Jeremiah's Hebrew.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 25:24; servir os caldeus
decisions.reason: The verse keeps the Portuguese of 2 Kings 25:24 at each level, except where the Hebrew differs: here the commanders are told not to fear "serving" the Chaldeans, where Kings has their "servants" (m1).

decisions.choice: 2 Kings 25:24 copied, with "ከለዳውያንን ለማገልገል አትፍሩ" (do not be afraid to serve the Chaldeans) for Kings' "የከለዳውያንን ባሪያዎች አትፍሩ".
decisions.reason: The meaning decision names this difference from Kings; the rest of Gedaliah's oath is the same in Hebrew and keeps the Kings wording at each level.

decisions.choice: कसदियों की सेवा करने से (L, B); बाबुलियों की (R)
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 25:24 has "of the servants of the Chaldeans" (कसदियों के दासों से); this verse has "to serve the Chaldeans", so the Hindi of 2 Kings is kept with only that change.

pt.R: Eu vou ficar aqui em Mispá e falar por vocês aos babilônios que vierem até nós. Mas vocês devem fazer a colheita do vinho, das frutas de verão e do azeite de oliva, e guardar tudo nos seus jarros. Depois morem nas cidades de que vocês tomaram posse."

am.L: እኔም እነሆ፣ ወደ እኛ በሚመጡት በከለዳውያን ፊት እቆም ዘንድ በምጽጳ እቀመጣለሁ፤ እናንተ ግን የወይን ጠጅንና የበጋ ፍሬን ዘይትንም አከማቹ፤ በዕቃዎቻችሁም አኑሩ፤ በያዛችኋቸውም ከተሞቻችሁ ተቀመጡ።»
am.B: እኔ ግን ወደ እኛ በሚመጡት በከለዳውያን ፊት እናንተን ወክዬ እንድቆም በምጽጳ እቀመጣለሁ። እናንተ ግን የወይን ጠጁን፣ የበጋውን ፍሬና ዘይቱን አከማቹ፤ በማሰሮዎቻችሁም አኑሩ፤ በያዛችኋቸውም ከተሞች ኑሩ።»
am.R: እኔ እዚህ በምጽጳ እቀመጣለሁ፤ ወደ እኛ ለሚመጡት ለባቢሎናውያንም ስለ እናንተ እናገራለሁ። እናንተ ግን የወይን ጠጁን፣ የበጋውን ፍሬና የወይራ ዘይቱን ሰብስቡ፤ በማሰሮዎቻችሁም አኑሩ። ከዚያም በያዛችኋቸው ከተሞች ተቀመጡ።»

hi.L: और मैं, देखो, मैं मिस्पा में रहता हूँ कि उन कसदियों के सामने खड़ा रहूँ जो हमारे पास आएँगे; पर तुम दाखरस और धूपकाल के फल और तेल इकट्ठा करो, और [उन्हें] अपने बर्तनों में रखो, और अपने उन नगरों में बसे रहो जिन्हें तुमने ले लिया है।"
hi.B: मैं तो मिस्पा में रहूँगा, कि जो कसदी हमारे पास आएँ, उनके सामने तुम्हारी ओर से खड़ा रहूँ। पर तुम दाखरस, धूपकाल के फल और तेल इकट्ठा करके अपने घड़ों में रखो, और उन नगरों में रहो जिन्हें तुमने अपने अधिकार में ले लिया है।"
hi.R: मैं यहीं मिस्पा में रहूँगा और जो बाबुली हमारे पास आएँगे, उनसे तुम्हारी ओर से बात करूँगा। पर तुम दाखरस, गर्मी के फल और जैतून का तेल इकट्ठा करके अपने घड़ों में रख लो। फिर उन नगरों में बस जाओ जिन्हें तुमने अपने अधिकार में ले लिया है।"

ru.L: А я вот живу в Мицпе, чтобы предстоять перед халдеями, которые придут к нам; а вы собирайте вино, и летние плоды, и масло, и кладите в ваши сосуды, и живите в ваших городах, которые вы заняли.»
ru.B: А я останусь в Мицпе, чтобы отвечать за вас перед халдеями, которые будут приходить к нам. Вы же собирайте вино, летние плоды и масло, складывайте их в свои кувшины и живите в городах, которые вы заняли.»
ru.R: Я останусь здесь, в Мицпе, и буду говорить за вас с вавилонянами, которые придут к нам. А вы соберите вино, летние плоды и оливковое масло и запасите их в своих кувшинах. Потом поселитесь в городах, которые вы заняли.»

ja.L: そしてわたしは、見なさい、ミツパに住んで、わたしたちのところに来るカルデア人の前に立つ。しかしあなたがたは、ぶどう酒と夏の果物と油を集め、あなたがたの器に入れ、あなたがたが取ったあなたがたの町々に住め。」
ja.B: わたし自身は、ミツパにとどまり、わたしたちのところに来るカルデア人の前に立って、あなたがたの代わりに応対する。しかしあなたがたは、ぶどう酒と夏の果物と油を集めて、かめに蓄え、あなたがたが手に入れた町々に住みなさい。」
ja.R: わたしはここミツパにとどまって、わたしたちのところに来るバビロン人に、あなたたちのために話をする。だから、あなたたちは、ぶどう酒と夏の果物とオリーブ油を集めて、かめに蓄えなさい。そして、あなたたちが手に入れた町々に住みなさい。」

decisions.choice: to stand before the Chaldeans: to answer to them on the people's behalf
decisions.reason: To "stand before" someone is to serve and attend on them, as an official stands before a king (52:12). Gedaliah will be the one who deals with the Babylonian officers, so that the people can get on with their lives.

decisions.choice: wine, summer fruit and oil: the late summer and autumn harvest
decisions.reason: The city fell in the fifth month, midsummer (52:12). Grapes, figs and other summer fruit, and olives were ripening in the following months, and the fields of those taken into exile had no one else to harvest them. "Wine" and "oil" here name the crops gathered to make them.

decisions.choice: your towns that you have taken over
decisions.reason: The verb means "seize" or "take hold of". The towns had been emptied by war and exile, and the commanders and their men had occupied them. Gedaliah tells them to settle there.

decisions.choice: jars (Balanced, Readable); olive oil, gather in (Readable)
decisions.reason: The "vessels" were storage jars. Readable says "olive oil" and "gather in" to make the harvest clear (m2).

decisions.choice: estar diante de (L); representar vocês diante de (B); falar por vocês a (R)
decisions.reason: To stand before someone is to serve and answer to him (m1); Literal keeps the idiom, and Balanced and Readable say what Gedaliah's task will be, as the English does.

decisions.choice: तुम्हारी ओर से खड़ा रहूँ (B); तुम्हारी ओर से बात करूँगा (R)
decisions.reason: To stand before the Chaldeans means to answer to them for the people; Balanced and Readable add "on your behalf", as the English levels say "represent you" and "speak for you".

decisions.choice: "предстоять перед халдеями" (L); "отвечать за вас перед халдеями" (B); "говорить за вас с вавилонянами" (R)
decisions.reason: To stand before them is to answer to them for the people (m1); Literal keeps the picture.

decisions.choice: la'amod lifnei "…の前に立つ" (L), "…の前に立って、あなたがたの代わりに応対する" (B), "あなたたちのために話をする" (R).
decisions.reason: m1: to answer to the Chaldeans on the people's behalf.
