records.literal_gloss: And also all the Judeans who [were] in Moab and among [the] sons of Ammon and in Edom, and who [were] in all the lands, heard that had given [the] king of Babylon a remnant to Judah, and that he had appointed over them Gedaliah son of Ahikam son of Shaphan,

en.L: And also all the Judeans who [were] in Moab and among the {{gender:children|sons}} of Ammon and in Edom, and who [were] in all the lands, heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant to Judah, and that he had appointed over them Gedaliah son of Ahikam son of Shaphan,
en.B: Likewise, all the Judeans who were in Moab, among the Ammonites, in Edom and in all the other lands heard that the king of Babylon had allowed a remnant to stay in Judah, with Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, set over them,
en.R: All the Judeans who were living in Moab, Ammon, Edom and the other countries heard about this. They heard that the king of Babylon had let some people stay in Judah, and that he had put Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, in charge of them.

es.L: Y también todos los judíos que [estaban] en Moab, y entre los hijos de Amón, y en Edom, y los que [estaban] en todas las tierras, oyeron que el rey de Babilonia había dejado un remanente en Judá, y que había puesto sobre ellos a Gedalías hijo de Ahicam, hijo de Safán,
es.B: Asimismo, todos los judíos que estaban en Moab, entre los amonitas, en Edom y en todas las demás tierras oyeron que el rey de Babilonia había dejado un remanente en Judá, y que había puesto sobre ellos a Gedalías hijo de Ahicam, hijo de Safán,
es.R: Todos los judíos que vivían en Moab, en Amón, en Edom y en los demás países se enteraron de esto. Oyeron que el rey de Babilonia había dejado que algunas personas se quedaran en Judá, y que había puesto a Gedalías hijo de Ahicam, hijo de Safán, a cargo de ellos.

fr.L: Et aussi tous les Judéens qui [étaient] en Moab, et parmi les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Ammon, et en Édom, et qui [étaient] dans tous les pays, apprirent que le roi de Babylone avait laissé un reste à Juda, et qu’il avait établi sur eux Guedalia fils d’Ahiqam, fils de Shaphân,
fr.B: De même, tous les Judéens qui étaient en Moab, chez les Ammonites, en Édom et dans tous les autres pays apprirent que le roi de Babylone avait permis à un reste de demeurer en Juda, et qu’il avait établi sur eux Guedalia fils d’Ahiqam, fils de Shaphân,
fr.R: Tous les Judéens qui vivaient en Moab, en Ammon, en Édom et dans les autres pays l’ont appris. Ils ont appris que le roi de Babylone avait laissé quelques personnes rester en Juda, et qu’il avait mis Guedalia fils d’Ahiqam, fils de Shaphân, à leur tête.

sw.L: Tena Wayahudi wote waliokuwa Moabu, na kati ya wana wa Amoni, na Edomu, na waliokuwa katika nchi zote, waliposikia kwamba mfalme wa Babeli amewaachia Yuda mabaki, na kwamba amemweka juu yao Gedalia mwana wa Ahikamu mwana wa Shafani,
sw.B: Vivyo hivyo, Wayahudi wote waliokuwa Moabu, kati ya Waamoni, Edomu na katika nchi nyingine zote walisikia kwamba mfalme wa Babeli ameruhusu mabaki wabaki Yuda, na kwamba amemweka Gedalia mwana wa Ahikamu, mwana wa Shafani, juu yao,
sw.R: Wayahudi wote waliokuwa wakiishi Moabu, Amoni, Edomu na nchi nyingine walisikia habari hii. Walisikia kwamba mfalme wa Babeli amewaruhusu watu wachache wabaki Yuda, na kwamba amemweka Gedalia mwana wa Ahikamu, mwana wa Shafani, kuwa msimamizi wao.

vi.L: Cũng vậy, tất cả những người Giu-đa ở trong Mô-áp, giữa con cái Am-môn, trong Ê-đôm và trong mọi xứ, nghe rằng vua Ba-by-lôn đã để lại một số người sót lại cho Giu-đa, và đã lập Ghê-đa-lia con trai A-hi-cam, con trai Sa-phan, cai quản họ,
vi.B: Cũng vậy, tất cả những người Giu-đa ở Mô-áp, giữa dân Am-môn, ở Ê-đôm và ở mọi xứ khác nghe tin vua Ba-by-lôn đã để cho một số người sót lại ở Giu-đa, và đã lập Ghê-đa-lia con trai A-hi-cam, cháu Sa-phan, cai quản họ,
vi.R: Tất cả những người Giu-đa đang sống ở Mô-áp, Am-môn, Ê-đôm và các nước khác đều nghe tin ấy. Họ nghe rằng vua Ba-by-lôn đã để cho một số người ở lại Giu-đa, và đã giao cho Ghê-đa-lia con trai A-hi-cam, cháu Sa-phan, cai quản họ.

ko.L: 그리고 모압과 암몬 {{gender:자손|아들들}} 가운데와 에돔과 모든 나라에 있던 모든 유다 사람도, 바빌론 왕이 유다에 남은 자를 두었고, 사반의 손자 아히감의 아들 그다랴를 그들 위에 세웠다는 것을 듣고,
ko.B: 모압과 암몬과 에돔과 그 밖의 모든 나라에 있던 유다 사람들도, 바빌론 왕이 유다에 남은 사람들을 머물게 하고 사반의 손자요 아히감의 아들인 그다랴를 그들의 총독으로 세웠다는 소식을 들었다.
ko.R: 모압과 암몬과 에돔과 다른 나라들에 살던 유다 사람들도 이 소식을 들었다. 바빌론 왕이 몇몇 사람을 유다에 남아 있게 하고, 사반의 손자요 아히감의 아들인 그다랴에게 그들을 맡겼다는 것이다.

pt.L: E também todos os judeus que [estavam] em Moabe, e entre os filhos de Amom, e em Edom, e que [estavam] em todas as terras ouviram que o rei da Babilônia tinha deixado um remanescente a Judá, e que tinha posto sobre eles Gedalias, filho de Aicam, filho de Safã,
pt.B: Do mesmo modo, todos os judeus que estavam em Moabe, entre os amonitas, em Edom e em todas as outras terras ouviram que o rei da Babilônia tinha permitido que um remanescente ficasse em Judá, e que tinha posto Gedalias, filho de Aicam, filho de Safã, sobre eles,
pt.R: Todas as pessoas de Judá que estavam morando em Moabe, em Amom, em Edom e nos outros países ouviram falar disso. Ouviram que o rei da Babilônia tinha deixado algumas pessoas ficarem em Judá, e que tinha posto Gedalias, filho de Aicam, neto de Safã, como responsável por elas.

am.L: ደግሞም በሞዓብና በአሞን ልጆች መካከል በኤዶምም በአገሮችም ሁሉ የነበሩት አይሁድ ሁሉ የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ለይሁዳ ቅሬታን እንደ ተወ፣ በእነርሱም ላይ የሳፋንን ልጅ የአኪቃምን ልጅ ጎዶልያስን እንደ ሾመ ሰሙ፤
am.B: እንዲሁም በሞዓብ፣ በአሞናውያን መካከል፣ በኤዶምና በሌሎቹ አገሮች ሁሉ የነበሩት አይሁድ ሁሉ የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ቅሬታ በይሁዳ እንዲቀር እንደ ፈቀደና የሳፋንን ልጅ የአኪቃምን ልጅ ጎዶልያስን በእነርሱ ላይ እንደ ሾመ በሰሙ ጊዜ፣
am.R: በሞዓብ፣ በአሞን፣ በኤዶምና በሌሎቹ አገሮች ይኖሩ የነበሩት አይሁድ ሁሉ ይህን ሰሙ። የባቢሎን ንጉሥ አንዳንድ ሰዎች በይሁዳ እንዲቀሩ እንደ ፈቀደና የሳፋንን የልጅ ልጅ የአኪቃምን ልጅ ጎዶልያስን በእነርሱ ላይ ኃላፊ አድርጎ እንደ ሾመ ሰሙ።

hi.L: और जितने यहूदी मोआब में और {{gender:अम्मोन की सन्तान|अम्मोन के पुत्रों}} के बीच और एदोम में, और जितने सब देशों में [थे], उन्होंने भी सुना कि बाबुल के राजा ने यहूदा के लिए बचे हुए लोग छोड़ दिए हैं, और उसने शापान के पुत्र अहीकाम के पुत्र गदल्याह को उन पर ठहराया है,
hi.B: इसी तरह जितने यहूदी मोआब में, अम्मोनियों के बीच, एदोम में और दूसरे सब देशों में थे, उन्होंने सुना कि बाबुल के राजा ने कुछ बचे हुए लोगों को यहूदा में रहने दिया है, और शापान के पोते, अहीकाम के पुत्र गदल्याह को उन पर ठहराया है,
hi.R: जो यहूदी मोआब, अम्मोन, एदोम और दूसरे देशों में रह रहे थे, उन्होंने भी इसके बारे में सुना। उन्होंने सुना कि बाबुल के राजा ने कुछ लोगों को यहूदा में रहने दिया है, और शापान के पोते, अहीकाम के पुत्र गदल्याह को उनका अधिकारी बनाया है।

ru.L: И также все иудеи, которые [были] в Моаве, и среди {{gender:детей Аммона|сынов Аммона}}, и в Едоме, и которые [были] во всех землях, услышали, что царь Вавилона оставил остаток Иуде и что поставил над ними Годолию, сына Ахикама, сына Шафана,
ru.B: Так же и все иудеи, которые были в Моаве, у аммонитян, в Едоме и во всех других землях, услышали, что царь Вавилона позволил остатку остаться в Иуде и поставил над ними Годолию, сына Ахикама, сына Шафана,
ru.R: Все иудеи, которые жили в Моаве, Аммоне, Едоме и других странах, услышали об этом. Они услышали, что царь Вавилона позволил части народа остаться в Иуде и поставил над ними начальником Годолию, сына Ахикама, сына Шафана.

ja.L: また、モアブに、アンモンの子らの中に、エドムに、またすべての地にいたすべてのユダの人々も、バビロンの王がユダに残りの者を残したこと、また、シャファンの子アヒカムの子ゲダルヤを彼らの上に任命したことを聞いた。
ja.B: 同じように、モアブにも、アンモン人の中にも、エドムにも、そのほかのすべての地にもいたすべてのユダの人々は、バビロンの王がユダに残りの者をとどまらせ、シャファンの子アヒカムの子ゲダルヤを彼らの上に立てたことを聞いた。
ja.R: モアブやアンモンやエドム、そのほかの国々に住んでいたすべてのユダの人々も、このことを聞きました。バビロンの王が、一部の人々をユダに残し、シャファンの孫で、アヒカムの息子であるゲダルヤを、その人々の責任者にしたというのです。

decisions.choice: Judeans in Moab, Ammon and Edom: refugees from the invasions
decisions.reason: Moab, Ammon and Edom lay east and southeast of Judah, across the Jordan and the Dead Sea. People of Judah had fled there during the Babylonian invasions; verse 12 says they had been "driven" there.

decisions.choice: the Judeans: the people of the kingdom of Judah
decisions.reason: The word means people of Judah. The later word "Jew" comes from it, but here it names the people of the kingdom that had just fallen.

decisions.choice: had given a remnant to Judah: had allowed some of the people to remain
decisions.reason: The king of Babylon had not emptied the land completely. A remnant was left, and Gedaliah was set over them.

decisions.choice: the sentence runs on into verse 12
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced end with a comma, since the sentence continues. Readable makes two sentences and says "let some people stay" for "gave a remnant".

decisions.choice: un remanente (L, B); algunas personas (R)
decisions.reason: "Remnant" is "el remanente" at Literal and Balanced in this translation; Readable says who they were. "Hijos de Amón" already includes women, so no gender span.

decisions.choice: "mabaki" (L, B); "watu wachache" (R)
decisions.reason: The word set for the remnant: "mabaki" at Literal and Balanced, as Romans 9:27 and 2 Kings 19:31; Readable says it plainly. "wana wa Amoni" at Literal takes no gender span: "wana" already includes daughters.

decisions.choice: một số người sót lại (L, B); một số người (R)
decisions.reason: The remnant, as the terms note sets it: "những người sót lại" at Literal and Balanced, said plainly at Readable. "Con cái Am-môn" (L) needs no gender span, since "con cái" already includes daughters.

decisions.choice: "암몬 {{gender:자손|아들들}}" (L); "암몬" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Korean has two wordings for "the sons of Ammon" as the English setting does; Balanced and Readable name the people, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "남은 자" (L), "남은 사람들" (B), "몇몇 사람" (R) for the remnant
decisions.reason: The terms note's forms for *sheʾerit*.

decisions.choice: os judeus (L, B), as pessoas de Judá (R); os filhos de Amom (L), os amonitas (B); um remanescente
decisions.reason: "Os judeus" at Literal and Balanced, as 32:12 sets it for the book, and "as pessoas de Judá" at Readable (m2). For the whole book (as already in 9:25; 25:21; 27:3): "os filhos de Amom" at Literal with no gender setting, since "filhos" already includes daughters, as for "os filhos de Israel", and "os amonitas" at Balanced and Readable, as the English. "O remanescente" is Isaiah's word (m3).

decisions.choice: no gender span: "የአሞን ልጆች".
decisions.reason: "ልጆች" already means children of either sex in Amharic, so the two English options read the same (docs/amharic-style.md 7b).

decisions.choice: {{gender:अम्मोन की सन्तान|अम्मोन के पुत्रों}}
decisions.reason: The gender span the Hindi already uses for "the sons of Ammon" as a people, where the English Literal has one; Balanced says अम्मोनी and Readable names the land, as the English.

decisions.choice: बचे हुए लोग
decisions.reason: The remnant in the terms note's form for Literal and Balanced; Readable says "some people" as the English.

decisions.choice: {{gender:детей Аммона|сынов Аммона}}
decisions.reason: The gender span of the English Literal, in the form used for Ammon elsewhere in this translation.

decisions.choice: "иудеи"; "остаток" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The people of the kingdom of Judah (m2), as 2 Kings 25:25 in this translation; the remnant is "остаток", as the Prophets note sets, and Readable says what it means (m3).

decisions.choice: hayyehudim "ユダの人々" (every level), not "ユダヤ人"; benei 'Ammon "アンモンの子ら" (L), "アンモン人" (B), "アンモン" (R); she'erit "残りの者" (L, B), "一部の人々" (R).
decisions.reason: m2: the people of the kingdom of Judah; ユダヤ人 suggests the later Jews. The JER-4 form for Ammon; no gender span, since アンモンの子ら / アンモン人 are already inclusive.

decisions.choice: The verb "聞いた" closes verse 11; verse 12 starts "そして…帰って来た".
decisions.reason: As 40:7: the English sentence runs on, Japanese ends each verse with its own verb.

source.text: וַיָּשֻׁ֣בוּ כָל־הַיְּהוּדִ֗ים מִכָּל־הַמְּקֹמוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִדְּחוּ־שָׁ֔ם וַיָּבֹ֧אוּ אֶֽרֶץ־יְהוּדָ֛ה אֶל־גְּדַלְיָ֖הוּ הַמִּצְפָּ֑תָה וַיַּאַסְפ֛וּ יַ֥יִן וָקַ֖יִץ הַרְבֵּ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃פ

records.literal_gloss: and returned all the Judeans from all the places where they had been driven there, and they came [to the] land of Judah to Gedaliah [to] Mizpah, and they gathered wine and summer fruit very much exceedingly.

en.L: and all the Judeans returned from all the places where they had been driven, and they came to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah at Mizpah, and they gathered wine and summer fruit in very great abundance.
en.B: and all the Judeans returned from all the places where they had been scattered. They came back to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah at Mizpah, and brought in a very large harvest of wine and summer fruit.
en.R: So all these Judeans came back to the land of Judah from all the places where they had been scattered. They came to Gedaliah at Mizpah. And they gathered a very large harvest of wine and summer fruit.

es.L: y volvieron todos los judíos de todos los lugares adonde habían sido arrojados, y vinieron a la tierra de Judá, a Gedalías, a Mizpa, y recogieron vino y fruta de verano en gran abundancia.
es.B: y todos los judíos regresaron de todos los lugares por donde habían sido dispersados. Volvieron a la tierra de Judá, a Gedalías en Mizpa, y recogieron una cosecha muy abundante de vino y fruta de verano.
es.R: Así que todos estos judíos regresaron a la tierra de Judá desde todos los lugares donde habían sido dispersados. Fueron a ver a Gedalías en Mizpa. Y recogieron una cosecha muy grande de uvas para el vino y de fruta de verano.

fr.L: et tous les Judéens revinrent de tous les lieux où ils avaient été chassés, et ils vinrent au pays de Juda, auprès de Guedalia, à Mitspa, et ils récoltèrent du vin et des fruits d’été en très grande abondance.
fr.B: et tous les Judéens revinrent de tous les lieux où ils avaient été dispersés. Ils rentrèrent au pays de Juda, auprès de Guedalia, à Mitspa, et ils firent une très abondante récolte de vin et de fruits d’été.
fr.R: Alors tous ces Judéens sont revenus au pays de Juda, de tous les endroits où ils avaient été dispersés. Ils sont venus auprès de Guedalia, à Mitspa. Et ils ont fait une très grosse récolte de vin et de fruits d’été.

sw.L: Ndipo Wayahudi wote wakarudi kutoka mahali pote walipokuwa wamefukuzwa, wakaja katika nchi ya Yuda, kwa Gedalia huko Mizpa, wakakusanya divai na matunda ya kiangazi mengi sana.
sw.B: Wayahudi wote walirudi kutoka mahali pote walipokuwa wametawanyika. Wakarudi katika nchi ya Yuda, kwa Gedalia huko Mizpa, wakavuna divai na matunda ya kiangazi kwa wingi sana.
sw.R: Basi Wayahudi hao wote walirudi katika nchi ya Yuda kutoka mahali pote walipokuwa wametawanyika. Wakaja kwa Gedalia huko Mizpa. Wakavuna divai na matunda ya kiangazi kwa wingi sana.

vi.L: thì tất cả những người Giu-đa trở về từ mọi nơi họ đã bị đuổi đến, và họ đến xứ Giu-đa, đến với Ghê-đa-lia tại Mích-ba; họ thu góp rượu và trái cây mùa hạ rất nhiều.
vi.B: thì tất cả những người Giu-đa từ mọi nơi họ đã bị tản lạc trở về. Họ trở về xứ Giu-đa, đến với Ghê-đa-lia tại Mích-ba, và thu hoạch được rất nhiều rượu và trái cây mùa hạ.
vi.R: Vậy tất cả những người Giu-đa ấy từ mọi nơi họ đã bị tản lạc trở về xứ Giu-đa. Họ đến với Ghê-đa-lia tại Mích-ba. Và họ thu hoạch được rất nhiều rượu và trái cây mùa hạ.

ko.L: 모든 유다 사람이 그들이 쫓겨 갔던 모든 곳에서 돌아와 유다 땅 미스바로 그다랴에게 왔다. 그리고 그들이 포도주와 여름 과일을 아주 많이 거두었다.
ko.B: 그래서 모든 유다 사람이 흩어져 있던 모든 곳에서 돌아왔다. 그들은 유다 땅 미스바로 그다랴에게 와서, 포도주와 여름 과일을 아주 많이 거두었다.
ko.R: 그래서 이 유다 사람들은 흩어져 살던 모든 곳에서 유다 땅으로 돌아왔다. 그들은 미스바에 있는 그다랴에게 왔다. 그리고 그들은 포도주와 여름 과일을 아주 많이 거두었다.

pt.L: e todos os judeus voltaram de todos os lugares para onde tinham sido expulsos, e vieram à terra de Judá, a Gedalias, [em] Mispá, e recolheram vinho e frutas de verão em grande abundância.
pt.B: e todos os judeus voltaram de todos os lugares para onde tinham sido espalhados. Vieram de volta à terra de Judá, a Gedalias, em Mispá, e fizeram uma colheita muito grande de vinho e de frutas de verão.
pt.R: Então todas essas pessoas de Judá voltaram para a terra de Judá de todos os lugares para onde tinham sido espalhadas. Vieram a Gedalias, em Mispá. E fizeram uma colheita muito grande de vinho e de frutas de verão.

am.L: አይሁድም ሁሉ ከተባረሩበት ስፍራ ሁሉ ተመለሱ፤ ወደ ይሁዳም ምድር ወደ ምጽጳ ወደ ጎዶልያስ መጡ፤ የወይን ጠጅንና የበጋ ፍሬን እጅግ በጣም ብዙ አድርገው አከማቹ።
am.B: አይሁድ ሁሉ ከተበተኑበት ስፍራ ሁሉ ተመለሱ። ወደ ይሁዳ ምድር ወደ ምጽጳ ወደ ጎዶልያስ ተመልሰው መጡ፤ እጅግ ብዙ የወይን ጠጅና የበጋ ፍሬም አከማቹ።
am.R: ስለዚህ እነዚህ አይሁድ ሁሉ ከተበተኑበት ስፍራ ሁሉ ወደ ይሁዳ ምድር ተመለሱ። ወደ ምጽጳ ወደ ጎዶልያስ መጡ። እጅግ ብዙ የወይን ጠጅና የበጋ ፍሬም ሰበሰቡ።

hi.L: तब सब यहूदी उन सब स्थानों से जहाँ वे हाँक दिए गए थे लौट आए, और यहूदा देश में मिस्पा में गदल्याह के पास आए; और उन्होंने बहुत ही अधिक दाखरस और धूपकाल के फल इकट्ठा किए।
hi.B: तब सब यहूदी उन सब स्थानों से लौट आए जहाँ वे तितर-बितर कर दिए गए थे। वे यहूदा देश में मिस्पा में गदल्याह के पास आए, और उन्होंने दाखरस और धूपकाल के फलों की बहुत बड़ी उपज इकट्ठा की।
hi.R: इसलिए ये सब यहूदी उन सब स्थानों से जहाँ वे बिखर गए थे, यहूदा देश लौट आए। वे मिस्पा में गदल्याह के पास आए। और उन्होंने दाखरस और गर्मी के फलों की बहुत बड़ी फ़सल इकट्ठा की।

ru.L: и вернулись все иудеи из всех мест, куда они были изгнаны, и пришли в землю Иуды, к Годолии в Мицпу, и собрали вина и летних плодов весьма много.
ru.B: и все иудеи вернулись из всех мест, куда были рассеяны. Они пришли в землю Иуды, к Годолии в Мицпу, и собрали очень большой урожай вина и летних плодов.
ru.R: Так все эти иудеи вернулись в землю Иуды из всех мест, где они были рассеяны. Они пришли к Годолии в Мицпу. И они собрали очень большой урожай вина и летних плодов.

ja.L: そして、すべてのユダの人々は、追いやられていたすべての所から帰って来て、ユダの地のミツパのゲダルヤのもとに来た。そして彼らは、ぶどう酒と夏の果物を非常に多く集めた。
ja.B: そして、すべてのユダの人々は、散らされていたすべての所から帰って来た。彼らはユダの地に戻り、ミツパのゲダルヤのもとに来た。そして、ぶどう酒と夏の果物を非常に豊かに取り入れた。
ja.R: こうして、これらのユダの人々はみな、散らされていた所からユダの地に帰って来ました。そして、ミツパのゲダルヤのところへ来ました。人々は、ぶどう酒と夏の果物を、とてもたくさん取り入れました。

decisions.choice: a small first return
decisions.reason: "The places where they had been driven" is the language Jeremiah uses for the LORD's promise to bring his people back (23:3, 8; 29:14; 32:37). For a short time the scattered people of Judah come home and the land gives its harvest. The next chapter shows how quickly this hope was broken.

decisions.choice: a very large harvest
decisions.reason: The harvest Gedaliah had told them to gather (verse 10) was plentiful. Oil is not named this time; the olives ripened last, later in the autumn.

decisions.choice: scattered (Balanced, Readable); a very large harvest (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The verb means to be driven away or scattered. Balanced and Readable turn "they gathered wine and summer fruit very much" into "a very large harvest".

decisions.choice: धूपकाल के फल (L, B); गर्मी के फल (R)
decisions.reason: Summer fruit (qayits) as Isaiah 16:9 in Hindi at Literal and Balanced; Readable uses the everyday word.

en.L: And Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces who [were] in the open country came to Gedaliah at Mizpah,
en.B: Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces who were in the open country came to Gedaliah at Mizpah
en.R: Johanan son of Kareah and all the army commanders who were out in the open country came to Gedaliah at Mizpah.

es.L: Y Johanán hijo de Carea y todos los jefes de las tropas que [estaban] en el campo vinieron a Gedalías, a Mizpa,
es.B: Johanán hijo de Carea y todos los jefes de las tropas que estaban en el campo fueron a ver a Gedalías en Mizpa
es.R: Johanán hijo de Carea y todos los jefes del ejército que todavía estaban en el campo fueron a ver a Gedalías en Mizpa.

fr.L: Et Yohanân fils de Qaréah et tous les chefs des troupes qui [étaient] dans la campagne vinrent auprès de Guedalia, à Mitspa,
fr.B: Yohanân fils de Qaréah et tous les chefs des troupes qui étaient dans la campagne vinrent trouver Guedalia à Mitspa
fr.R: Yohanân fils de Qaréah et tous les chefs de l’armée qui étaient encore dans la campagne sont venus voir Guedalia à Mitspa.

sw.L: Naye Yohana mwana wa Karea na wakuu wote wa majeshi waliokuwa nyikani wakaja kwa Gedalia huko Mizpa,
sw.B: Yohana mwana wa Karea na wakuu wote wa majeshi waliokuwa nyikani walikuja kwa Gedalia huko Mizpa,
sw.R: Yohana mwana wa Karea na makamanda wote wa jeshi waliokuwa nyikani walikuja kwa Gedalia huko Mizpa.

vi.L: Giô-ha-nan con trai Ca-rê-át và tất cả các tướng chỉ huy quân lính ở ngoài đồng đến với Ghê-đa-lia tại Mích-ba,
vi.B: Giô-ha-nan con trai Ca-rê-át và tất cả các tướng chỉ huy quân lính đang ở ngoài đồng đến gặp Ghê-đa-lia tại Mích-ba
vi.R: Giô-ha-nan con trai Ca-rê-át và tất cả các tướng chỉ huy quân đội còn ở ngoài đồng đến gặp Ghê-đa-lia tại Mích-ba.

decisions.choice: Do you indeed know ...? an urgent warning
decisions.reason: The verb is doubled for emphasis: "knowing, do you know?" It is a pressing question that means "Surely you know" or "You must realize".

decisions.choice: Baalis king of Ammon
decisions.reason: Ammon lay east of the Jordan. Its king had once joined Judah in plotting against Babylon (27:3). Why he wanted Gedaliah dead is not said; a governor loyal to Babylon may have stood in his way. After the murder Ishmael fled to the Ammonites (41:10, 15).

decisions.choice: to strike you in life: to kill you
decisions.reason: "To strike someone in life" means to strike a fatal blow (Genesis 37:21; Deuteronomy 19:6, 11).

decisions.choice: strike you dead (Literal); murder you (Balanced); kill you (Readable); Do you realize (Balanced)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of a blow; Balanced and Readable give the sense (m3). Balanced puts the doubled verb as "Do you realize" (m1).

decisions.choice: The commanders address Gedaliah in 합쇼체 as "총독님"
decisions.reason: Korean needs an address for "you"; "총독님" is respectful and names his office (2 Kings 25:22 B).

decisions.choice: você (the commanders to Gedaliah); Baalis; tirar a sua vida (L), assassinar (B), matar (R)
decisions.reason: The commanders speak to Gedaliah, one of their own people, with "você", as Gedaliah speaks to them with "vocês" (verse 9) and as 2 Kings 25:24 has it; he is the governor, but not a king. Literal says "tirar a sua vida", the Portuguese idiom that keeps "life" (m3).

decisions.choice: the commanders speak to Gedaliah with the respectful "እርስዎ" ("ያውቃሉን?", "ነፍስዎን"); Gedaliah answers with "አንተ".
decisions.reason: Gedaliah is the governor set over them by the king of Babylon; subordinates address a ruler with "እርስዎ", as the terms lists ask for a king, while he speaks down to them.

decisions.choice: आप to Gedaliah; बालीस
decisions.reason: The commanders speak to the governor the king of Babylon set over them and say आप, as people do to a ruler; Gedaliah answers them with तुम. Baalis is named only here: बालीस.

decisions.choice: "Ваалис"
decisions.reason: The traditional Russian Bible form of the Ammonite king's name (m2).

decisions.choice: "Знаешь ли ты точно"; "поразить тебя насмерть"
decisions.reason: Literal marks the doubled verb with "точно" and keeps the picture of a deadly blow (m3); Balanced and Readable say "убить".

decisions.choice: The commanders to the governor: plain at L (the Hebrew's blunt "Do you indeed know?"), polite at B and R ("ご存じですか" / "知っていますか").
decisions.reason: m1: an urgent warning to a superior; the 2 Kings 25 tone (2KI-4) has officers speak politely to their chief at B and R.

decisions.choice: Baalis "バアリス" (new name).
decisions.reason: m2: transcription of the Hebrew.

records.literal_gloss: And Johanan son of Kareah said to Gedaliah in secret at Mizpah, saying, Let me go, please, and let me strike Ishmael son of Nethaniah, and a man will not know; why should he strike you [in] life, and be scattered all Judah who are gathered to you, and perish [the] remnant of Judah?

en.L: And Johanan son of Kareah spoke to Gedaliah in secret at Mizpah, saying, "Let me go, please, and strike down Ishmael son of Nethaniah, and no one will know. Why should he strike you dead, and all Judah who are gathered to you be scattered, and the remnant of Judah perish?"
en.B: Then Johanan son of Kareah spoke to Gedaliah privately at Mizpah. "Please let me go and kill Ishmael son of Nethaniah," he said, "and no one will know. Why should he take your life, so that all the Judeans gathered around you are scattered and the remnant of Judah perishes?"
en.R: Then Johanan son of Kareah spoke to Gedaliah in private at Mizpah. "Please let me go and kill Ishmael son of Nethaniah," he said. "Nobody will find out who did it. Why should he kill you? Then all the people of Judah who have gathered around you would be scattered, and the few people left in Judah would be wiped out."

es.L: Y Johanán hijo de Carea habló a Gedalías en secreto en Mizpa, diciendo: «Déjame ir, por favor, y mataré a Ismael hijo de Netanías, y nadie lo sabrá. ¿Por qué ha de quitarte la vida, y se dispersen todos los de Judá que se han reunido en torno a ti, y perezca el remanente de Judá?».
es.B: Entonces Johanán hijo de Carea le habló a Gedalías en privado en Mizpa. «Por favor, déjame ir a matar a Ismael hijo de Netanías», le dijo, «y nadie lo sabrá. ¿Por qué ha de quitarte la vida, para que se dispersen todos los judíos reunidos en torno a ti y perezca el remanente de Judá?».
es.R: Luego Johanán hijo de Carea le habló a Gedalías en privado en Mizpa. «Por favor, déjame ir a matar a Ismael hijo de Netanías», le dijo. «Nadie sabrá quién lo hizo. ¿Por qué ha de matarte él? Si lo hace, toda la gente de Judá que se ha reunido en torno a ti se dispersará, y los pocos que quedan en Judá serán destruidos».

fr.L: Et Yohanân fils de Qaréah parla en secret à Guedalia, à Mitspa, disant : « Laisse-moi donc aller frapper Ismaël fils de Netania, et personne ne le saura. Pourquoi t’ôterait-il la vie, et tout Juda qui s’est rassemblé auprès de toi serait-il dispersé, et le reste de Juda périrait-il ? »
fr.B: Alors Yohanân fils de Qaréah parla en privé à Guedalia, à Mitspa : « Laisse-moi aller tuer Ismaël fils de Netania, je t’en prie, dit-il ; personne ne le saura. Pourquoi te prendrait-il la vie, de sorte que tous les Judéens rassemblés autour de toi seraient dispersés et que le reste de Juda périrait ? »
fr.R: Alors Yohanân fils de Qaréah a parlé à Guedalia en privé, à Mitspa. « S’il te plaît, laisse-moi aller tuer Ismaël fils de Netania, lui a-t-il dit. Personne ne saura qui l’a fait. Pourquoi te laisserais-tu tuer ? Tous les gens de Juda qui se sont rassemblés autour de toi seraient dispersés, et le peu de gens qui restent en Juda disparaîtraient. »

sw.L: Naye Yohana mwana wa Karea akasema na Gedalia kwa siri huko Mizpa, kusema, "Tafadhali niache niende nikampige Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania, wala hakuna mtu atakayejua. Kwa nini akuue, na Wayahudi wote waliokusanyika kwako watawanyike, na mabaki ya Yuda yaangamie?"
sw.B: Kisha Yohana mwana wa Karea akazungumza na Gedalia faraghani huko Mizpa. Akasema, "Tafadhali niruhusu niende nikamuue Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania, wala hakuna mtu atakayejua. Kwa nini akuue, hata Wayahudi wote waliokusanyika kwako watawanyike, na mabaki ya Yuda yaangamie?"
sw.R: Kisha Yohana mwana wa Karea akazungumza na Gedalia kwa siri huko Mizpa. Akasema, "Tafadhali niruhusu niende nikamuue Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania. Hakuna mtu atakayejua ni nani aliyefanya hivyo. Kwa nini akuue? Hapo watu wote wa Yuda waliokusanyika kwako wangetawanyika, na watu wachache waliobaki Yuda wangeangamizwa."

vi.L: Giô-ha-nan con trai Ca-rê-át nói kín với Ghê-đa-lia tại Mích-ba rằng: "Xin để tôi đi đánh giết Ích-ma-ên con trai Nê-tha-nia, và sẽ không ai biết. Sao để hắn đánh lấy mạng ông, khiến cả Giu-đa đang tụ họp quanh ông bị tản lạc, và những người sót lại của Giu-đa bị diệt mất?"
vi.B: Bấy giờ Giô-ha-nan con trai Ca-rê-át nói riêng với Ghê-đa-lia tại Mích-ba: "Xin để tôi đi giết Ích-ma-ên con trai Nê-tha-nia, và sẽ không ai biết. Sao lại để hắn lấy mạng ông, khiến mọi người Giu-đa đang tụ họp quanh ông bị tản lạc, và những người sót lại của Giu-đa bị diệt mất?"
vi.R: Bấy giờ Giô-ha-nan con trai Ca-rê-át nói riêng với Ghê-đa-lia tại Mích-ba: "Xin để tôi đi giết Ích-ma-ên con trai Nê-tha-nia. Sẽ không ai biết ai đã làm. Sao lại để hắn giết ông? Khi ấy mọi người Giu-đa đang tụ họp quanh ông sẽ bị tản lạc, và số ít người còn lại ở Giu-đa sẽ bị tiêu diệt."

ko.L: 그리고 가레아의 아들 요하난이 미스바에서 그다랴에게 은밀히 말했다. "제가 가서 느다냐의 아들 이스마엘을 치게 해 주십시오. 아무도 알지 못할 것입니다. 왜 그가 총독님의 목숨을 쳐서, 총독님께 모인 온 유다가 흩어지고 유다의 남은 자가 멸망해야 합니까?"
ko.B: 그러자 가레아의 아들 요하난이 미스바에서 그다랴에게 은밀히 말했다. "제가 가서 느다냐의 아들 이스마엘을 죽이게 해 주십시오. 아무도 모를 것입니다. 왜 그가 총독님의 목숨을 빼앗아, 총독님 곁에 모인 유다 사람들이 모두 흩어지고 유다의 남은 사람들이 멸망하게 해야 합니까?"
ko.R: 그러자 가레아의 아들 요하난이 미스바에서 그다랴에게 몰래 말했다. "제가 가서 느다냐의 아들 이스마엘을 죽이게 해 주십시오. 누가 그랬는지 아무도 모를 것입니다. 왜 그가 총독님을 죽이게 두어야 합니까? 그러면 총독님 곁에 모인 유다 사람들이 모두 흩어지고, 유다에 살아남은 몇 안 되는 사람들도 없어지고 말 것입니다."

pt.L: E Joanã, filho de Careá, falou a Gedalias em segredo, em Mispá, dizendo: "Deixe-me ir, por favor, e ferir Ismael, filho de Netanias, e ninguém saberá. Por que ele tiraria a sua vida, e todo Judá que se reuniu a você seria espalhado, e o remanescente de Judá pereceria?"
pt.B: Então Joanã, filho de Careá, falou com Gedalias em particular, em Mispá. "Por favor, deixe-me ir e matar Ismael, filho de Netanias", disse ele, "e ninguém vai saber. Por que ele tiraria a sua vida, de modo que todos os judeus reunidos ao seu redor fossem espalhados e o remanescente de Judá perecesse?"
pt.R: Então Joanã, filho de Careá, falou com Gedalias em particular, em Mispá. "Por favor, deixe-me ir e matar Ismael, filho de Netanias", disse ele. "Ninguém vai descobrir quem fez isso. Por que ele mataria você? Então todas as pessoas de Judá que se reuniram ao seu redor seriam espalhadas, e as poucas pessoas que restaram em Judá seriam destruídas."

am.L: የቃሬያም ልጅ ዮሐናን በምጽጳ ለጎዶልያስ በስውር እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው፦ «እባክዎ ልሂድ፤ የናታንያንም ልጅ እስማኤልን ልምታው፤ ማንም አያውቅም፤ ለምን ነፍስዎን ይመታል? ወደ እርስዎ የተሰበሰቡት ይሁዳ ሁሉ ለምን ይበተናሉ? የይሁዳስ ቅሬታ ለምን ይጠፋል?»
am.B: ከዚያም የቃሬያ ልጅ ዮሐናን በምጽጳ ለጎዶልያስ በግል ተናገረው። «እባክዎ ልሂድና የናታንያን ልጅ እስማኤልን ልግደለው» አለ፤ «ማንም አያውቅም። ወደ እርስዎ የተሰበሰቡት አይሁድ ሁሉ እንዲበተኑና የይሁዳ ቅሬታ እንዲጠፋ ለምን ሕይወትዎን ያጥፋ?»
am.R: ከዚያም የቃሬያ ልጅ ዮሐናን በምጽጳ ለጎዶልያስ በምስጢር ተናገረው። «እባክዎ ልሂድና የናታንያን ልጅ እስማኤልን ልግደለው» አለ። «ማን እንደ ገደለው ማንም አያውቅም። እርሱ ለምን ይግደልዎ? ያን ጊዜ በዙሪያዎ የተሰበሰቡት የይሁዳ ሰዎች ሁሉ ይበተናሉ፤ በይሁዳ የቀሩት ጥቂት ሰዎችም ይጠፋሉ።»

hi.L: और कारेह के पुत्र योहानान ने मिस्पा में गदल्याह से गुप्त में कहा, "मुझे जाने दीजिए, कृपया, कि मैं नतन्याह के पुत्र इश्माएल को मार डालूँ, और कोई न जानेगा। वह आपके प्राण क्यों मारे, और सब यहूदी जो आपके पास इकट्ठे हुए हैं तितर-बितर हो जाएँ, और यहूदा के बचे हुए लोग नाश हो जाएँ?"
hi.B: तब कारेह के पुत्र योहानान ने मिस्पा में गदल्याह से अकेले में बात की। "कृपया मुझे जाने दीजिए कि मैं नतन्याह के पुत्र इश्माएल को मार डालूँ," उसने कहा, "और किसी को पता नहीं चलेगा। वह आपकी जान क्यों ले, जिससे आपके चारों ओर इकट्ठे हुए सब यहूदी तितर-बितर हो जाएँ और यहूदा के बचे हुए लोग नाश हो जाएँ?"
hi.R: तब कारेह के पुत्र योहानान ने मिस्पा में गदल्याह से अकेले में बात की। "कृपया मुझे जाने दीजिए कि मैं नतन्याह के पुत्र इश्माएल को मार डालूँ," उसने कहा। "किसी को पता नहीं चलेगा कि यह किसने किया। वह आपको क्यों मार डाले? तब तो आपके चारों ओर इकट्ठे हुए यहूदा के सब लोग बिखर जाएँगे, और यहूदा में जो थोड़े-से लोग बचे हैं, वे भी मिट जाएँगे।"

ru.L: А Иоанан, сын Карея, сказал Годолии тайно в Мицпе так: «Позволь мне пойти, прошу, и я поражу Измаила, сына Нафании, и никто не узнает. Зачем ему поражать тебя насмерть, чтобы рассеялся весь Иуда, собравшийся к тебе, и погиб остаток Иуды?»
ru.B: Тогда Иоанан, сын Карея, тайно заговорил с Годолией в Мицпе. «Позволь мне пойти и убить Измаила, сына Нафании», — сказал он, — «и никто не узнает. Зачем ему лишать тебя жизни, чтобы все иудеи, собравшиеся вокруг тебя, рассеялись и остаток Иуды погиб?»
ru.R: Тогда Иоанан, сын Карея, тайно поговорил с Годолией в Мицпе. «Позволь мне пойти и убить Измаила, сына Нафании», — сказал он. — «Никто не узнает, кто это сделал. Зачем ему убивать тебя? Тогда все люди Иуды, которые собрались вокруг тебя, разбегутся, и те немногие, кто остался в Иуде, погибнут.»

ja.L: そしてカレアの子ヨハナンは、ミツパでひそかにゲダルヤに言った。「どうか行かせてください。ネタンヤの子イシュマエルを打ちます。だれにも知られません。なぜ彼があなたの命を打ち、あなたのもとに集まっているすべてのユダが散らされ、ユダの残りの者が滅びなければならないのですか？」
ja.B: そこで、カレアの子ヨハナンは、ミツパでひそかにゲダルヤに話した。「どうか、わたしに行かせて、ネタンヤの子イシュマエルを殺させてください」と彼は言った。「だれにも分かりません。どうして彼にあなたの命を奪わせ、あなたのもとに集まったユダの人々をみな散らし、ユダの残りの者を滅びさせてよいでしょうか？」
ja.R: そこで、カレアの息子ヨハナンは、ミツパでゲダルヤとこっそり話しました。「どうか、わたしに行かせてください。ネタンヤの息子イシュマエルを殺してきます」とヨハナンは言いました。「だれがやったか、だれにも分かりません。どうして、あの男にあなたを殺させてよいでしょうか？そんなことになれば、あなたのところに集まったユダの人々はみな散らされ、ユダに残ったわずかな人々も、滅んでしまいます。」

decisions.choice: a man will not know: no one will find out
decisions.reason: "A man" here means anyone at all. Johanan offers to do it secretly, so that Gedaliah would not be blamed.

decisions.choice: what was at stake: the survival of the remnant
decisions.reason: Johanan sees that Gedaliah's death would scatter the people gathered to him and destroy what was left of Judah. That is what happened: after the murder the people fled, first toward Ammon and then to Egypt (41:10-18; 43:5-7).

decisions.choice: all Judah: all the people of Judah gathered at Mizpah
decisions.reason: "Judah" here is the people, not the territory: those who had come to Gedaliah (verse 12).

decisions.choice: Nobody will find out who did it (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable says what no one would know. It also turns the long question into a short question and a statement of the result.

decisions.choice: so that ... are scattered (Balanced); Then ... would be scattered (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew joins the results to the question with "and". Balanced and Readable make clear that the scattering would follow from Gedaliah's death.

decisions.choice: सब यहूदी (L, B), यहूदा के सब लोग (R); यहूदा के बचे हुए लोग (L, B), जो थोड़े-से लोग बचे हैं (R)
decisions.reason: "All Judah" means the people of Judah gathered at Mizpah. The remnant takes the terms note's forms.

decisions.choice: "все иудеи" (B); "все люди Иуды" (R)
decisions.reason: "All Judah" here means all the people of Judah gathered at Mizpah (m3); Literal keeps "весь Иуда".

decisions.choice: Johanan to Gedaliah in です・ます at every level ("行かせてください"), as a subordinate asking his governor's leave.
decisions.reason: A request with "na'" (please) to a superior.

records.literal_gloss: And said Gedaliah son of Ahikam to Johanan son of Kareah, Do not do the thing this, for falsehood you [are] speaking about Ishmael.

en.L: And Gedaliah son of Ahikam said to Johanan son of Kareah, "Do not do this thing, for you are speaking falsehood about Ishmael."
en.B: But Gedaliah son of Ahikam answered Johanan son of Kareah, "You must not do this! What you are saying about Ishmael is false."
en.R: But Gedaliah son of Ahikam told Johanan son of Kareah, "Do not do this! What you are saying about Ishmael is not true."

es.L: Y Gedalías hijo de Ahicam dijo a Johanán hijo de Carea: «No hagas esto, porque hablas mentira acerca de Ismael».
es.B: Pero Gedalías hijo de Ahicam le respondió a Johanán hijo de Carea: «¡No hagas eso! Lo que dices de Ismael es falso».
es.R: Pero Gedalías hijo de Ahicam le dijo a Johanán hijo de Carea: «¡No hagas eso! Lo que dices de Ismael no es verdad».

fr.L: Et Guedalia fils d’Ahiqam dit à Yohanân fils de Qaréah : « Ne fais pas cette chose, car c’est un mensonge que tu dis au sujet d’Ismaël. »
fr.B: Mais Guedalia fils d’Ahiqam répondit à Yohanân fils de Qaréah : « Ne fais pas cela ! Ce que tu dis d’Ismaël est un mensonge. »
fr.R: Mais Guedalia fils d’Ahiqam a dit à Yohanân fils de Qaréah : « Ne fais pas cela ! Ce que tu dis d’Ismaël n’est pas vrai. »

sw.L: Lakini Gedalia mwana wa Ahikamu akamwambia Yohana mwana wa Karea, "Usilitende jambo hili, kwa maana unasema uongo juu ya Ishmaeli."
sw.B: Lakini Gedalia mwana wa Ahikamu akamjibu Yohana mwana wa Karea, "Usifanye jambo hili! Unayosema juu ya Ishmaeli ni uongo."
sw.R: Lakini Gedalia mwana wa Ahikamu akamwambia Yohana mwana wa Karea, "Usifanye hivyo! Unayosema juu ya Ishmaeli si kweli."

vi.L: Ghê-đa-lia con trai A-hi-cam nói với Giô-ha-nan con trai Ca-rê-át: "Đừng làm việc này, vì anh nói điều giả dối về Ích-ma-ên."
vi.B: Nhưng Ghê-đa-lia con trai A-hi-cam đáp với Giô-ha-nan con trai Ca-rê-át: "Anh không được làm việc này! Điều anh nói về Ích-ma-ên là sai sự thật."
vi.R: Nhưng Ghê-đa-lia con trai A-hi-cam bảo Giô-ha-nan con trai Ca-rê-át: "Đừng làm vậy! Điều anh nói về Ích-ma-ên không đúng sự thật."

ko.L: 그러자 아히감의 아들 그다랴가 가레아의 아들 요하난에게 말했다. "이 일을 하지 마시오. 당신이 이스마엘에 관하여 거짓을 말하고 있소."
ko.B: 그러나 아히감의 아들 그다랴는 가레아의 아들 요하난에게 대답했다. "그런 일을 해서는 안 되오! 당신이 이스마엘에 관하여 하는 말은 거짓이오."
ko.R: 그러나 아히감의 아들 그다랴는 가레아의 아들 요하난에게 말했다. "그런 일을 하지 마시오! 당신이 이스마엘에 관하여 하는 말은 사실이 아니오."

pt.L: E Gedalias, filho de Aicam, disse a Joanã, filho de Careá: "Não faça esta coisa, pois você está falando falsidade a respeito de Ismael."
pt.B: Mas Gedalias, filho de Aicam, respondeu a Joanã, filho de Careá: "Não faça isso! O que você está dizendo sobre Ismael é falso."
pt.R: Mas Gedalias, filho de Aicam, disse a Joanã, filho de Careá: "Não faça isso! O que você está dizendo sobre Ismael não é verdade."

am.L: የአኪቃም ልጅ ጎዶልያስም የቃሬያን ልጅ ዮሐናንን፦ «ይህን ነገር አታድርግ፤ ስለ እስማኤል የምትናገረው ሐሰት ነውና» አለው።

ja.R: しかし、アヒカムの息子ゲダルヤは、カレアの息子ヨハナンに言いました。「そんなことをしてはいけない。あなたがイシュマエルについて言っていることは、うそだ。」

decisions.choice: falsehood: Gedaliah thinks the report untrue
decisions.reason: The word means something false. Gedaliah does not necessarily accuse Johanan of lying on purpose; he refuses to believe the report. It proves true in 41:1-3, where Ishmael kills him at a meal.

decisions.choice: Do not do: the margin's form of the verb
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew text and the scribes' marginal reading give two forms of the verb "do". The meaning is the same, and the marginal reading is followed.

decisions.choice: Gedaliah's trust
decisions.reason: Gedaliah refuses a secret killing and trusts a man of his own people. The story does not blame him outright, but the next chapter shows the cost of not heeding the warning.

decisions.choice: is false (Balanced); is not true (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the stress on the report, not on Johanan's honesty (m1).

decisions.choice: mentira (L); falso (B); no es verdad (R)
decisions.reason: *Sheqer* is "mentira" in this translation; here it is Gedaliah's mistaken charge, and Balanced and Readable soften it to "false" and "not true" as the English does.

decisions.choice: "c’est un mensonge" (L, B); "n’est pas vrai" (R)
decisions.reason: *Sheqer* is "le mensonge" at Literal and Balanced in French Jeremiah; Readable says plainly that it is untrue.

decisions.choice: anh (Gedaliah to Johanan)
decisions.reason: The governor answers one of his commanders with "anh", the word of a superior who trusts him; the commanders say "ông" to the governor.

decisions.choice: "거짓" (L, B); "사실이 아니오" (R) for *sheqer*
decisions.reason: The terms note's word for falsehood; Readable says it plainly.

decisions.choice: sheqer "偽り" (L, B), "うそ" (R), as JER-5.
decisions.reason: m1: Gedaliah thinks the report untrue.
